284 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Dewan Komisaris merupakan salah satu organ Perseroan yang berfungsi untuk melakukan pengawasan secara umum dan/atau khusus sesuai Anggaran Dasar Perseroan serta memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi dalam menjalankan kepengurusan Perseroan. Dalam kaitan dengan pelaksanaan praktik Governansi Korporasi, Dewan Komisaris memiliki tugas dan tanggung jawab memantau secara berkelanjutan efektivitas praktik Governansi Korporasi yang diterapkan Perseroan dan memberikan saran atas pelaksanaan Governansi Korporasi di lingkungan Perseroan.
Dua Tingkatan Fungsi Pengawasan Dewan Komisaris: 1. Level Performance, yaitu fungsi Dewan Komisaris melakukan pengawasan dengan memberikan pengarahan dan petunjuk kepada Direksi serta memberikan masukan dalam RUPS; dan 2. Level Conformance, yaitu berupa pelaksanaan kegiatan pengawasan pada tahap selanjutnya untuk memastikan nasihat telah dijalankan serta dipenuhinya ketentuan dalam peraturan perundang-Dewan Komisaris Board of Commissioners The Board of Commissioners is one of the Corporation’s organs that functions to carry out general and/or specific supervision in accordance with the Corporation’s Articles of Association and to provide advice to the Board of Directors in carrying out the management of the Corporation. In relation to the implementation of Corporate Governance practices, the Board of Commissioners has the duty and responsibility to continuously monitor the effectiveness of Corporate Governance practices implemented by the Corporation and to provide advice on the implementation of Corporate Governance within the Corporation.
Two Levels of the Board of Commissioners' Supervisory Function: 1. Performance Level, namely the function of the Board of Commissioners to carry out supervision by providing direction and instructions to the Board of Directors and providing input in the GMS; and 2. Conformance Level, namely in the form of implementing supervisory activities at the next stage to ensure that advice has been implemented and that the provisions in the applicable laws and regulations Dewan Komisaris melakukan site visit Board of Commissioners conducts a site visit 285 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report undangan dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan yang berlaku.
Ketentuan Masa Jabatan Dewan Komisaris Mengacu pada ketentuan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan Anggota Dewan Komisaris diangkat oleh RUPS setelah melaksanakan uji kelayakan dan kepatutan, untuk jangka waktu 4 tahun dengan tidak mengurangi hak RUPS untuk memberhentikannya sewaktu-waktu.
Jabatannya anggota Dewan Komisaris berakhir, jika: 1. Kehilangan kewarganegaraan Indonesia; 2. Mengundurkan diri; 3. Tidak lagi memenuhi persyaratan perundang-undangan; 4. Meninggal dunia; 5. Diberhentikan berdasarkan keputusan RUPS; 6. Tidak mencapai standar kinerja yang ditetapkan berdasarkan alasan yang objektif; 7. Dipidana penjara karena terbukti melakukan perbuatan pidana yang telah berkekuatan hukum tetap; dan 8. Masa jabatannya berakhir.

Term of Office for the Board of Commissioners Referring to the provisions of the Corporation's Articles of Association, members of the Board of Commissioners are appointed by the GMS after carrying out a fit and proper test, for a period of 4 years without reducing the GMS right to dismiss them at any time.
The term of office of the Board of Commissioners ends if she/he: 1. Loses Indonesian citizenship; 2. Resigns; 3. No longer meets the requirements of the law; 4. Passes away; 5. Is dismissed based on a resolution of the GMS; 6. Does not achieve the performance standards set based on objective reasons; 7. Is sentenced to imprisonment for being proven to have committed a criminal act that has permanent legal force; and 8. His/her term of office ends.

Komisaris Independen Merujuk pada UU Perseroan Terbatas khususnya di Pasal 120, ketentuan terkait Komisaris Independen tidak bersifat wajib, dan Anggaran Dasar tidak mengatur mengenai Komisaris Independen. Selanjutnya, berdasarkan ketentuan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, pengangkatan Komisaris Independen dilakukan melalui mekanisme RUPS, dan sepanjang tahun 2024, tidak terdapat keputusan RUPS yang mengangkat Komisaris Independen. Board Manual dan Pedoman Kerja Dewan Komisaris Dalam menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya, Dewan Komisaris mengacu pada peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Selain itu, Perseroan juga telah Menyusun Pedoman Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi atau Board Manual, yang ditetapkan Perseroan melalui Keputusan Bersama Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) No. 010 Tahun 2024 dan No. 053 Tahun 2024 tentang Pedoman Kerja Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi (Board Manual).
Pernyataan tentang independensi masing-masing Komisaris Pada tahun 2024, Perseroan tidak memiliki Komisaris Independen. Sehingga tidak terdapat informasi terkait pernyataan independensi masing-masing Komisaris Independen.
Independent Commissioner Referring to the Limited Liability Corporation Law, especially in Article 120, the provisions regarding Independent Commissioners are not mandatory, and the Articles of Association do not regulate Independent Commissioners. Furthermore, based on the provisions of applicable laws and regulations, the appointment of Independent Commissioners is carried out through the GMS mechanism, and throughout 2024, there was no GMS decision to appoint Independent Commissioners.
Board Manual and Work Guidelines for the Board of Commissioners In carrying out its duties and responsibilities, the Board of Commissioners refers to the applicable laws and regulations. In addition, the Corporation has also prepared Guidelines for the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors or the Board Manual, which was stipulated by the Corporation through Joint Decision of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors of PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) No. 010 of 2024 and No. 053 of 2024 on the Work Guidelines for the Board of Commissioners and Directors (Board Manual).
Statement regarding the independence of each Commissioner In 2024, the Corporation did not have any Independent Commissioners. Therefore, there is no information regarding the statement of independence of each Independent Commissioner.
288 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Tugas Dewan Komisaris Secara umum tugas Dewan Komisaris ada beberapa, yaitu: 1. Tugas berkaitan dengan Direksi; 2. Tugas berkaitan dengan pelaksanaan Good Corporate Governance; 3. Tugas berkaitan dengan RUPS/Pemegang Saham; 4. Tugas yang terkait dengan Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran; 5. Tugas yang terkait dengan Rencana Bisnis Perusahaan; 6. Tugas yang terkait dengan Laporan Tahunan; 7. Tugas berkaitan dengan Nominasi Anggota Dewan Komisaris, dan Direksi Anak Perusahaan dan/atau Perusahaan Patungan; 8. Tugas berkaitan dengan Pengelolaan Manajemen Risiko; 9. Tugas berkaitan dengan Sistem Pengendalian Internal; 10. Tugas berkaitan dengan pengawasan implementasi ISO; dan 11. Tugas berkaitan dengan Sistem Manajemen Anti-Penyuapan.
Selain itu, Dewan Komisaris juga memiliki peranan khusus terkait dengan penerapan GRC Terintegrasi sebagaimana diatur dalam Pedoman GRC Terintegrasi yang disahkan berdasarkan Keputusan Bersama Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi No. 001 Tahun 2023 dan No. 006 Tahun 2023 sebagai berikut: 1. Melakukan evaluasi terhadap kebijakan GRC Terintegrasi dan kebijakan-kebijakan turunannya; 2. Melakukan evaluasi pertanggungjawaban Direksi atas pelaksanaan GRC Terintegrasi, serta memberikan arahan atau nasihat kepada Direksi atas pelaksanaan GRC Terintegrasi; 3. Melakukan evaluasi dan memutuskan permohonan Direksi yang berkaitan dengan transaksi yang memerlukan persetujuan Dewan Komisaris; 4. Melaksanakan pengawasan terhadap pelaksanaan fungsi GRC Terintegrasi sesuai dengan kebijakan yang berlaku di Perseroan, ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan, anggaran dasar, dan keputusan RUPS; dan 5. Mengawasi penerapan GRC Anak Perusahaan agar selaras dengan penerapan GRC Induk.
Wewenang Dewan Komisaris Dalam menjalankan peran dan fungsinya, Dewan Komisaris memiliki wewenang yaitu: 1. Dewan Komisaris berwenang untuk menyetujui atau menolak secara tertulis rencana Direksi dalam hal: Duties of the Board of Commissioners In general, there are several duties of the Board of Commissioners, as follows: 1. Duties related to the Board of Directors; 2. Duties related to the implementation of Good Corporate Governance; 3. Duties related to the GMS/Shareholders; 4. Duties related to the Work Plan and Budget; 5. Duties related to the Corporation’s Business Plan; 6. Duties related to the Annual Report; 7. Duties related to the Nomination of Members of the Board of Commissioners, and the Board of Directors of Subsidiaries and/or Joint Ventures; 8. Duties related to Risk Management; 9. Duties related to the Internal Control System; 10. Duties related to the supervision of ISO implementation; and 11. Duties related to the Anti-Bribery Management System.
Furthermore, the Board of Commissioners also has a special role related to the implementation of Integrated GRC as regulated in the Integrated GRC Guidelines ratified based on Joint Decision of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors No. 001 of 2023 and No. 006 of 2023 as follows: 1. Evaluating the Integrated GRC policy and its derivative policies; 2. Evaluating the responsibility of the Board of Directors for implementing Integrated GRC and providing direction or advice to the Board of Directors for the implementation of Integrated GRC; 3. Evaluating and deciding on the Board of Directors’ requests relating to transactions that require the approval of the Board of Commissioners; 4. Supervising the implementation of the Integrated GRC function in accordance with the policies applicable in the Corporation, provisions of laws and regulations, articles of association, and the GMS resolutions; and 5. Overseeing the implementation of the Subsidiary’s GRC so that it is in line with the implementation of the Parent’s GRC.
Authority of the Board of Commissioners In carrying out its role and function, the Board of Commissioners has the following authorities: 1. The Board of Commissioners has the authority to approve or reject in writing the Board of Directors’ plan in the case of: 289 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report a. Meminjam atau meminjamkan uang atas nama Perseroan (tidak termasuk mengambil uang Perseroan di Bank); dan b. Mendirikan suatu usaha baru atau turut serta pada Perseroan lain, baik di dalam maupun di luar negeri.
2. Dewan Komisaris setiap waktu dalam jam kerja kantor berhak memasuki bangunan dan halaman atau tempat lain yang dipergunakan atau yang dikuasai oleh Perseroan dan berhak memeriksa semua pembukuan, surat dan alat bukti lainnya, memeriksa dan mencocokkan keadaan uang kas dan lain-lain, serta berhak untuk mengetahui segala tindakan yang telah dijalankan oleh Direksi; 3. Dewan Komisaris berwenang untuk mengesahkan perubahan Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran (RKA) Perseroan yang berpengaruh terhadap perubahan anggaran pendapatan dan/atau belanja Perseroan kurang dari 10%; 4. Mendapat penjelasan tentang segala hal yang ditanyakan kepada Direksi dan Anggota Direksi; 5. Melaksanakan kepengurusan Perseroan jika terjadi kekosongan jabatan seluruh Anggota Direksi. Dalam hal tersebut, Dewan Komisaris dapat menunjuk pejabat dari Internal Perseroan untuk membantu pelaksanaan tugas Direksi, sampai dengan pengangkatan Direksi definitif, paling lama 6 bulan; 6. Memberikan masukan, saran, dan pertimbangan kepada Direksi; 7. Memberikan teguran dan peringatan kepada Direksi atas pengelolaan/pengurusan Perseroan yang tidak sesuai dengan, Rencana Bisnis Perusahaan, Rencana Strategis Bisnis (Renstra), dan/atau Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Perseroan; 8. Memeriksa Direksi yang diduga melakukan tindakan yang merugikan Perseroan; 9. Meminta data dan informasi mengenai kegiatan usaha Perseroan dan/atau pengelolaan/pengurusan Perseroan oleh Direksi; 10. Meminta penjelasan dari Direksi mengenai perkembangan Perseroan; 11. Meminta Direksi dan/atau pejabat lainnya di bawah Direksi dengan sepengetahuan Direksi untuk menghadiri rapat Dewan Komisaris; 12. Memberikan penilaian terhadap kinerja Direksi Perseroan; 13. Membentuk Komite Audit dan komite Dewan Komisaris Lainnya yang bekerja secara kolektif, dan berfungsi membantu Dewan Komisaris dalam melaksanakan tugas pengawasan; a. Borrowing or lending money in the name of the Corporation (excluding taking the Corporation’s money from the Bank); and b. Establishing a new business or participating in another Corporation, either domestically or abroad.
2. The Board of Commissioners at any time during office hours has the right to enter the building and yard or other place used or controlled by the Corporation and has the right to examine all books, letters, and other evidence, examine and match the condition of cash and others, and has the right to know all actions that have been taken by the Board of Directors; 3. The Board of Commissioners has the authority to ratify changes to the Corporation’s Work Plan and Budget (RKA) that affect changes to the Corporation’s revenue and/or expenditure budget of less than 10%; 4. Receiving an explanation of all matters asked to the Board of Directors and Members of the Board of Directors; 5. Carrying out the management of the Corporation if there is a vacancy in the positions of all Members of the Board of Directors. In such case, the Board of Commissioners may appoint officials from within the Corporation to assist in carrying out the duties of the Board of Directors, up to the appointment of definitive Directors, for a maximum of 6 months; 6. Providing input, suggestions, and considerations to the Board of Directors; 7. Providing reprimands and warnings to the Board of Directors for management/administration of the Corporation that is not in accordance with the Corporation’s Business Plan, Strategic Business Plan (Renstra), and/or the Corporation’s Work Plan and Budget; 8. Examining Directors who are suspected of committing actions that are detrimental to the Corporation; 9. Requesting data and information regarding the Corporation’s business activities and/or management/administration of the Corporation by the Board of Directors; 10. Requesting an explanation from the Board of Directors regarding the development of the Corporation; 11. Requesting the Board of Directors and/or other officials under the Board of Directors with the knowledge of the Board of Directors to attend the Board of Commissioners meeting; 12. Providing an assessment of the performance of the Corporation’s Board of Directors; 13. Forming an Audit Committee and other Board of Commissioners committees that work collectively, and function to assist the Board of Commissioners in carrying out supervisory duties; 290 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance 14. Memberikan teguran dan peringatan kepada Komite Dewan Komisaris atas kinerja yang tidak sesuai dengan standar yang sudah dipersyaratkan serta dapat memberhentikannya sewaktu-waktu sesuai dengan wewenang Dewan Komisaris; 15. Dapat mengangkat seorang Sekretaris Dewan Komisaris yang merupakan karyawan Perseroan yang ditugaskan oleh Direksi dan/atau pihak lainnya yang pada saat pengangkatnya juga menjadi karyawan perseroan melalui perikatan Perjanjian Kerja; 16. Memberikan persetujuan atas permohonan cuti yang diajukan oleh Direksi; dan 17. Memberikan persetujuan atas permohonan izin yang diajukan Direksi untuk perjalanan dinas luar negeri.
Tugas & Kewajiban Dewan Komisaris Tugas 1. Tugas berkaitan dengan Direksi; Dewan komisaris memiliki tugas sebagai berikut: a. Melakukan pengawasan terhadap Perseroan; b. Mengawasi dan memberi nasihat kepada Direksi dalam menjalankan pengurusan Perseroan. Pengawasan dan pemberian nasihat terhadap kepengurusan Perseroan ini di antaranya dalam aspek tata kelola sistem informasi dan teknologi, kebijakan pengembangan karir, kebijakan mutu, dan kebijakan pelaksanaan pengadaan barang dan jasa; c. Menilai kinerja direksi secara individu sesuai dengan ketentuan yang ditetapkan Perseroan, dan melaporkan hasil penilaian kinerja tersebut kepada Pemegang saham; d. Mengusulkan remunerasi Direksi sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku dan penilaian kinerja Direksi; e. Memberikan persetujuan atas rencana tindakan korporasi yang diajukan oleh Direksi untuk disetujui di dalam RUPS, sepanjang berdasarkan Anggaran Dasar dan Peraturan Perundang-undangan mewajibkan bahwa tindakan korporasi tersebut harus mendapatkan persetujuan Dewan Komisaris terlebih dahulu; f. Mengawasi dan memberi nasihat kepada Direksi atas kebijakan Perseroan selaku pemegang saham pada Anak Usaha dan/atau Perusahaan Patungan; dan g. Mengawasi dan memberi nasihat atas kebijakan akuntansi dan penyusunan laporan keuangan Perseroan.
14. Providing reprimands and warnings to the Board of Commissioners Committee for performance that does not comply with the required standards and may dismiss them at any time in accordance with the authority of the Board of Commissioners; 15. May appoint a Secretary to the Board of Commissioners who is an employee of the Corporation assigned by the Board of Directors and/ or other parties who at the time of appointment are also employees of the Corporation through an Employment Agreement; 16. Providing approval for leave requests submitted by the Board of Directors; and 17. Providing approval for permission requests submitted by the Board of Directors for overseas business travel.
Duties & Obligations of the Board of Commissioners Duties 1. Duties related to the Board of Directors; The Board of Commissioners has the following duties: a. Supervising the Corporation; b. Supervising and providing advice to the Board of Directors in carrying out the management of the Corporation. Supervision and provision of advice on the management of the Corporation include aspects of information and technology system governance, career development policies, quality policies, and policies for the implementation of procurement of goods and services; c. Assessing the performance of the Board of Directors individually in accordance with the provisions set by the Corporation, and report the results of the performance assessment to the Shareholders; d. Proposing remuneration for the Board of Directors in accordance with applicable provisions and the performance assessment of the Board of Directors; e. Providing approval for corporate action plans submitted by the Board of Directors for approval at the GMS, as long as the Articles of Association and Laws and Regulations require that such corporate actions must first obtain the approval of the Board of Commissioners; f. Supervising and providing advice to the Board of Directors on the Corporation’s policies as a shareholder in Subsidiaries and/or Joint Ventures; and g. Supervising and providing advice on the Corporation’s accounting policies and preparation of financial statements.

Tugas berkaitan dengan Pelaksanaan Good Corporate Governance; Dalam kaitan dengan pelaksanaan praktik Good Corporate Governance di lingkungan Perseroan, Dewan komisaris memiliki tugas dan tanggungjawab memantau secara berkelanjutan efektifitas praktik Good Corporate Governance yang diterapkan Perseroan dan memberikan saran atas pelaksanaan Good Corporate Governance di lingkungan Perseroan. 3. Tugas berkaitan dengan RUPS/Pemegang Saham; Dalam hubungannya dengan RUPS/Pemegang Saham, Dewan Komisaris bertugas untuk: a. Memimpin RUPS. Dalam hal Komisaris Utama berhalangan hadir, maka RUPS dipimpin oleh seorang Anggota Dewan Komisaris lainnya; b. Memberikan pendapat dan saran kepada Pemegang Saham atas: i. Program kerja yang diajukan Direksi; ii. Laporan keuangan Perseroan; iii. Laporan kinerja Perseroan; dan iv. Laporan akhir masa jabatan Direksi.
c. Melaporkan hasil pengawasan dalam RUPS; d. Melaporkan pembentukan Komite Dewan Komisaris kepada Pemegang Saham, serta memastikan pelaksanaan tugas dari komite-komite tersebut dan mendokumentasikan laporan-laporan hasil pekerjaan untuk disampaikan kepada Pemegang Saham, dalam bentuk laporan pengawasan Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Dewan Komisaris; e. Mengajukan usulan Indikator Pencapaian Kinerja (Key Performance Indicator) Perseroan kepada Pemegang Saham; f. Menyampaikan Laporan Triwulanan perkembangan realisasi indikator pencapaian kinerja kepada Pemegang Saham; g. Mengajukan calon auditor eksternal dalam RUPS yang dilengkapi dengan alasan pencalonannya. Dalam hal proses pengadaan auditor eksternal, Dewan Komisaris dapat mendelegasikannya kepada Direksi untuk diproses sesuai ketentuan pengadaan yang berlaku di Perseroan, namun untuk penetapan audit eksternal dilakukan oleh Dewan Komisaris. Dalam hasil auditnya, auditor eksternal menyampaikan hasil yakni berupa Opini atas Laporan Keuangan Perseroan yang diperiksa setelah proses audit berdasarkan kriteria yang ditetapkan dan dikomunikasikan kepada Dewan Komisaris, Direksi dan Organ Perseroan lainnya. Opini yang diberikan oleh Auditor Eksternal terdiri dari 5 jenis, yaitu Opini Wajar Tanpa Pengecualian (Unqualified Opinion), 2. Duties related to the Implementation of Good Corporate Governance; In relation to the implementation of Good Corporate Governance practices within the Corporation, the Board of Commissioners has the duty and responsibility to continuously monitor the effectiveness of Good Corporate Governance practices implemented by the Corporation and provide advice on the implementation of Good Corporate Governance within the Corporation.
3. Duties related to the GMS/Shareholders; In relation to the GMS/Shareholders, the Board of Commissioners has duties as follows: a. Leading the GMS. In the event that the President Commissioner is unable to attend, the GMS will be led by another Member of the Board of Commissioners.
b. Providing opinions and advice to Shareholders on: i. Work programs proposed by the Board of Directors; ii. The Corporation’s financial statements; iii. The Corporation’s performance report; and iv. The end-of-term report of the Board of Directors.
c. Reporting the supervision results in the GMS; d. Reporting the establishment of the Board of Commissioners Committee to Shareholders, as well as ensuring the implementation of the committees’ duties and documenting reports on work results to be submitted to Shareholders, in the form of a supervisory report of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Commissioners Committee; e. Submitting proposals for the Corporation’s Key Performance Indicators to Shareholders; f. Submitting Quarterly Reports on the progress of the realization of performance achievement indicators to Shareholders; g. Submitting candidates for external auditors to the GMS, complete with the reasons for their nomination. In terms of the external auditor procurement process, the Board of Commissioners may delegate it to the Board of Directors to be processed in accordance with the procurement provisions applicable in the Corporation, but the determination of the external audit is carried out by the Board of Commissioners. Meneliti, menelaah, dan menandatangani Laporan Tahunan yang disusun dan disampaikan oleh Direksi dalam RUPS. Mengkaji dan memberi pendapat atas Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran yang disampaikan oleh Direksi; dan b. Mengawasi penerapan Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Perseroan.
5. Tugas yang Terkait dengan Rencana Bisnis Perusahaan; a. Memberikan tanggapan dan persetujuan atas usulan atau revisi Rencana Bisnis Perusahaan yang disampaikan oleh Direksi; dan b. Dewan Komisaris bersama Direksi menandatangani Rencana Bisnis Perusahaan yang telah disepakati dan menyampaikannya kepada Pemegang Saham selambat-lambatnya 60 hari sebelum Rencana Bisnis Perusahaan periode sebelumnya habis masa berlakunya.

Menandatangani Laporan Tahunan sejak tanggal panggilan RUPS untuk dapat diperiksa oleh Pemegang Saham; dan c. Menyebutkan alasan secara tertulis, atau alasan dinyatakan dalam surat tersendiri yang dilampirkan dalam Laporan Tahunan jika tidak menandatangani Laporan Tahunan.
7. Tugas berkaitan dengan Nominasi Anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi Anak Perusahaan dan/atau Perusahaan Patungan; Dalam nominasi anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi anak perusahaan, a. Dewan Komisaris akan memberikan tanggapan tertulis atas usulan Direksi; dan Organs. Opinions given by the External Auditor consist of 5 types, namely Unqualified Opinion, Qualified Opinion, Adverse Opinion, Modified Unqualified Opinion, and Disclaimer of Opinion; h. Examining, reviewing, and signing the Annual Report prepared and submitted by the Board of Directors in the GMS. In the event that a member of the Board of Commissioners is unwilling to sign the Annual Report, the reason must be stated in writing; and i. Providing opinions and suggestions in the GMS regarding the corporate action plan by the Board of Directors which must be approved by the GMS.
4. Duties Related to the Work Plan and Budget; a. Reviewing and providing opinions on the Work Plan and Budget submitted by the Board of Directors; and b. Supervising the implementation of the Corporation’s Work Plan and Budget.
5. Duties Related to the Corporation’s Business Plan; a. Providing responses and approvals to proposals or revisions to the Corporation’s Business Plan submitted by the Board of Directors; and b. The Board of Commissioners together with the Board of Directors sign the agreed Corporation’s Business Plan and submit it to the Shareholders no later than 60 days before the Corporation’s Business Plan for the previous period expires.
6. Duties Related to the Annual Report; a. Reviewing the Annual Report submitted by the Board of Directors; b. Signing the Annual Report from the date of the GMS notice so that it can be examined by the Shareholders; and c. Stating the reasons in writing, or reasons stated in a separate letter attached to the Annual Report if not signing the Annual Report.

Tugas berkaitan dengan Sistem Pengendalian Internal; Dewan Komisaris mempunyai kewajiban untuk mengawasi dan memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi mengenai efektivitas penerapan Sistem Pengendalian Internal. 10. Tugas berkaitan dengan pengawasan implementasi ISO; Dewan Komisaris mempunyai kewajiban untuk mengawasi dan memberikan nasihat kepada Direksi mengenai pelaksanaan kebijakan mutu dan sistem manajemen berdasarkan standar ISO Perseroan. 11. Tugas berkaitan dengan Sisten Manajemen Anti Penyuapan; a. Memastikan penerapan Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuapan di Perseroan sesuai dengan peraturan yang berlaku; b. Kewajiban Dewan Komisaris 1. Dewan Komisaris bertanggung jawab melakukan pengawasan atas kebijakan pengurusan, jalannya pengurusan pada umumnya, baik mengenai Perseroan maupun usaha Perseroan, dan memberi nasihat kepada Direksi; 2. Mengikuti perkembangan kegiatan Perseroan, memberikan pendapat, dan saran dalam RUPS mengenai setiap masalah yang dianggap penting bagi kepengurusan Perseroan; b. The Corporation’s Board of Directors proposes to the Board of Commissioners to appoint representatives of the Corporation who are candidates for members of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners in Subsidiaries and/or Joint Ventures who make significant contributions to the Corporation and/or have strategic value.
8. Duties related to Risk Management Management; a. The Board of Commissioners is responsible for supervising and providing advice to the Board of Directors periodically and monitoring important risks (top risks) faced by the Corporation; and b. In connection with point 1, the Board of Commissioners may form a Committee that functions to monitor the management of the Corporation’s Risk Management which will cooperate with the Risk Management work unit.
9. Duties related to the Internal Control System; The Board of Commissioners has an obligation to supervise and provide advice to the Board of Directors regarding the effectiveness of the implementation of the Internal Control System.
10. Duties related to supervision of ISO implementation; The Board of Commissioners has an obligation to supervise and provide advice to the Board of Directors regarding the implementation of quality policies and management systems based on the Corporation’s ISO standards.
11. Duties related to the Anti-Bribery Management System; a. Ensuring the implementation of Anti-Bribery Management System in the Corporation in accordance with applicable regulations; b. Conducting periodic reviews of the Anti-Bribery Management System to align with the Corporation’s strategy; c. Receiving and reviewing information on the content and operation of the Anti-Bribery Management System at planned times; and d. Carrying out supervision of the implementation and effectiveness of the Anti-Bribery Management System implemented.

The Board of Commissioners is responsible for supervising management policies, the course of management in general, both regarding the Corporation and the Corporation’s business, and providing advice to the Board of Directors; 2. Following the development of the Corporation’s activities, providing opinions and suggestions in the GMS regarding any issues considered important to the management of the Corporation; 294 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance 3. Meneliti dan menelaah Laporan Tahunan yang disiapkan Direksi serta menandatangani Laporan Tahunan; 5. Melaporkan kepada Perseroan mengenai kepemilikan sahamnya dan/atau keluarganya pada Perseroan tersebut dan Perseroan lain, termasuk perubahannya; 6. Membentuk Organ Pendukung Komite Dewan Komisaris untuk membantu tugas pengawasan dan pemberian nasihat, dan melaporkannya di dalam RUPS, baik kepada pemegang saham mayoritas maupun minoritas, memastikan pelaksanaan serta mendokumentasikannya; dan 9. Melaksanakan kewajiban lainnya dalam rangka tugas pengawasan dan pemberian nasihat, sepanjang tidak bertentangan dengan peraturan perundang-undangan, Anggaran Dasar Perseroan, dan/atau keputusan RUPS.
Hak Dewan Komisaris 1. Menerima penghasilan yang paling banyak terdiri atas: a. Honorarium; b. Tunjangan; c. Fasilitas; dan/atau d. Tantiem atau insentif kinerja yang jumlahnya ditentukan oleh RUPS.
2. Melakukan pembagian kerja di antara para anggota Dewan Komisaris yang diatur oleh Dewan Komisaris sendiri; 3. Melaksanakan perjalanan dinas jika diperlukan dalam rangka mendukung tujuan Perseroan, dan mendapatkan ketentuan fasilitas perjalanan dinas sesuai dengan prinsip dan batas kewajaran, yang mana ketentuannya sama dan/atau tidak melebihi fasilitas perjalanan dinas bagi Direksi Perseroan; dan 4. Seorang anggota Dewan Komisaris berhak mengundurkan diri dari jabatannya dengan memberitahukan secara tertulis mengenai maksud tersebut kepada Perseroan sekurangnya 30 hari sebelum tanggal pengunduran dirinya. 3. Reporting immediately to the GMS if there are symptoms of declining Corporation performance that cause material impacts in accordance with the provisions of applicable laws and regulations; 4. Examining and reviewing the Annual Report prepared by the Board of Directors and signing the Annual Report; 5. Reporting to the Corporation regarding his/her and/ or his/her family’s share ownership in the Corporation and other Companies, including changes thereto; 6. Providing a report on the supervisory duties that have been carried out during the previous financial year in the GMS; 7. Preparing minutes of the Board of Commissioners’ meetings and keeping a copy thereof; 8. Forming a Supporting Organ of the Board of Commissioners’ Committee to assist in the supervisory and advisory duties, and reporting them in the GMS, both to the majority and minority shareholders, ensuring their implementation and documenting them; and 9. Carrying out other obligations in the context of the supervisory and advisory duties, as long as they do not conflict with laws and regulations, the Corporation’s Articles of Association, and/or GMS resolutions.
Rights of the Board of Commissioners 1. Receiving income consisting of the following: a. Honorarium; b. Allowances; c. Facilities; and/or d. Tantiem or performance incentives, the amount of which is determined by the GMS.
2. Dividing work among members of the Board of Commissioners as regulated by the Board of Commissioners it self; 3. Carrying out official travel, if necessary, in order to support the Corporation’s objectives, and obtaining provisions for official travel facilities in accordance with reasonable principles and limits, the provisions of which are the same and/or do not exceed official travel facilities for the Corporation’s Board of Directors; and 4. A member of the Board of Commissioners has the right to resign from his/her position by notifying the Corporation in writing of such intention at least 30 days before the date of his/her resignation.

Rincian Tugas Komisaris Utama Tugas Komisaris Utama adalah pengawasan menyeluruh berkaitan dengan Direksi, pelaksanaan Good Corporate Governance, RUPS/Pemegang Saham, Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran, Rencana Bisnis Perusahaan, Laporan Tahunan, Nominasi Anggota Dewan Komisaris, dan Direksi Anak Perusahaan dan/atau Perusahaan patungan, Pengelolaan Manajemen Risiko, Sistem Pengendalian Internal, pengawasan implementasi ISO, dan Sistem Manajemen Anti-Penyuapan. Jenis Keputusan yang Memerlukan Persetujuan Dewan Komisaris Sepanjang tidak ditentukan lain dalam Anggaran Dasar Perseroan maka wewenang Direksi memerlukan persetujuan tertulis dari Dewan Komisaris adalah sebagai berikut: 1. Melepaskan sebagian atau seluruh penyertaan modal Perseroan dalam Perusahaan lain; Division of Duties and Responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners The Board of Commissioners regulates and determines the division of duties among the Board of Commissioners’ members as regulated by the Board of Commissioners’ Decision. The division of duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners’ members in 2024 is based on the Board of Commissioners’ Decision No. 009/BOC-MRT/X/2024.
Details of the President Commissioner’s Duties The duties of the President Commissioner are comprehensive supervision related to the Board of Directors, implementation of Good Corporate Governance, GMS/Shareholders, Work Plan and Budget, Corporation Business Plan, Annual Report, Nomination of Members of the Board of Commissioners, and Board of Directors of Subsidiaries and/or Joint Ventures, Risk Management, Internal Control System, supervision of ISO implementation, and Anti-Bribery Management System.
Types of Decisions Requiring the Board of Commissioners’ Approval As long as it Is not specified otherwise in the Corporation’s Articles of Association, the authority of the Board of Directors requires written approval from the Board of Commissioners as follows: 1. Identifying internal and external factors that affect KPIs; e. Studying or benchmarking on how to manage performance and risk management in one unit; f. Compiling KPIs by considering risk; g. Considering the targets and achievements of KPIs in the previous year; and h. Adjusting the budget and resources.
2. Regarding human capital in the Business Development Directorate: a. Ensuring that Employee KPI scores are linear with NFB revenue achievements; b. Conducting more hard skills training; c. Changing the cost ratio; d. Adjusting KPI weights on impactful components (sales or revenue); e. Reviewing root causes in the Business Development Directorate; f. Paying attention to productivity and engagement; and g. Considering additional employees.
3. Improving employee productivity and corporate productivity measurements so that they are aligned; 4. Improving performance management; 5. Conducting FGDs or going directly to the field to listen to employee input; 6. Strengthening mechanisms for managing employees; 7. Improving KPIs and targets in the Business Development Directorate; 8. Compiling upside potential risks and downside potential risks related to the management of Blok M Terminal; 9. Conducting discussions with DKI Provincial Government; 10. Conducting employee hearings regarding fair distribution of incentives; 11. Arranging career levels; 12. Developing more effective intervention strategies to accelerate the process of achieving the competencies needed to achieve corporate targets; 303 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report 13. Memastikan bahwa kajian yang komprehensif dilakukan terhadap rencana perubahan klasifikasi prasarana yang sebelumnya tercatat sebagai aset tetap menjadi aset tidak berwujud (hak konsesi) yang kemudian ada amortisasi; 16. Melakukan audit ataupun uji kelayakan (due diligence) untuk hal ini; b. Memperhatikan aspek benturan kepentingan dari Kepala Divisi Internal Audit yang merangkap sebagai Komisaris ITJ; dan c. Menyiapkan kajian dari aspek bisnis dan keuangan.
26. Terkait realisasi penggunaan anggaran: a. Melakukan analisis keuangan secara rutin terhadap anomali (anggaran besar tapi penyerapan kecil) setiap bulannya; b. Melakukan performance based budgeting; c. Melaksanakan pemantauan bulanan serta analisis potensi terhadap anggaran belanja yang masih bisa dilakukan efisiensi (mencermati, menganalisis, dan mengontrol anggaran tertentu); dan d. Melakukan pengawasan pergerakan arus kas, terutama terkait Shareholder Loan yang sudah dikeluarkan untuk AU/PP .
13. Harmonizing with DKI Provincial Government, especially BPBUMD, regarding the implementation of Green Building pilot project; 14. Prioritizing the certification of Green Building Certification Indonesia (GBCI) program to be implemented in 2025; 15. Ensuring that a comprehensive study is conducted on the planned change in classification of infrastructure previously recorded as fixed assets to intangible assets (concession rights) which are then amortized; 16. Resolving the issue of construction finance charges; 17. Conducting more intensive monitoring related to this governance issue from the Internal Audit Division; 18. 26. Regarding the realization of budget use: a. Conducting routine financial analysis of anomalies (large budget but small absorption) every month; b. Conducting performance-based budgeting; c. Diutamakan KAP Big Four atau setidaknya Second Tier; b. Memastikan pelaksanaan audit oleh KAP telah sesuai dengan standar audit yang berlaku; c. Memastikan independensi dari KAP terhadap pekerjaan audit laporan keuangan; dan d. Pastikan ketepatan waktu (timeline) dan kesesuaian dengan pekerjaan di lapangan.
29. Melakukan negosiasi mengenai harga (audit fee) yang disesuaikan dengan anggaran perusahaan dan kebutuhan Manajemen; 30. Memastikan pengembalian SHL ITJ dilakukan tepat waktu; 31. Melakukan efisiensi tidak hanya pada Divisi FA, tapi melekat pada seluruh unit kerja sehingga bisa memberikan efek pada perbaikan kinerja keuangan MRT Jakarta; b. Menyusun pedoman Direksi bagi unit kerja untuk selalu melakukan efisiensi anggaran; c. Melakukan penyusunan anggaran yang lebih realistis; d. Menyusun kajian komprehensif atas program efisiensi; dan e. Melakukan penyisiran anggaran berdasarkan skala prioritas kegiatan dan menjaga pemenuhan Service Level Agreement (SLA).
34. Melakukan perhitungan nilai aset KJPP dilakukan lebih awal; 35. Melakukan penambahan ruang lingkup audit IT, tidak hanya IT maturity tapi juga IT security. Melakukan pemetaan kegiatan-kegiatan yang memang penting dan tidak begitu penting untuk dilakukan; 27. Regarding revenue projections: a. 28. Notes on selecting a KAP: a. Ensuring that the auditor team involved has the competence and capability, both technically and in terms of experience, to audit MRT Jakarta, especially in the railway business process, state finances, and loans. Big Four KAP or at least Second Tier is preferred; b. Ensuring that the audit implementation by KAP is in accordance with applicable audit standards; c. Ensuring the independence of KAP from the financial statements of audit work; and d. Ensuring timeliness and conformity with field work.

Preparing guidelines for the Board of Directors for work units to always carry out budget efficiency; c. Preparing a more realistic budget; d. Preparing a comprehensive study of the efficiency program; and e. Conducting budget searches based on the priority scale of activities and maintaining the fulfillment of the Service Level Agreement (SLA).

Rapat Dewan Komisaris Kebijakan Rapat Dewan Komisaris Sebagaimana diatur dalam Keputusan Bersama Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) No. 010 Tahun 2024 dan No. 053 Tahun 2024 tentang Pedoman Kerja Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi (Board Manual), rapat Dewan Komisaris diadakan secara berkala sekurang-kurangnya sekali dalam sebulan atau dapat dilakukan sewaktu-waktu sesuai dengan kebutuhan. Rapat Dewan Komisaris dibantu Sekretaris Dewan Komisaris untuk melakukan pencatatan risalah rapat.
Dalam rapat terserbut Dewan Komisaris dapat mengundang Direksi. Rapat Dewan Komisaris diadakan di tempat kedudukan Perseroan atau tempat kegiatan usaha Perseroan. Rapat Dewan Komisaris juga dapat juga dilakukan melalui media telekonferensi, video konferensi, atau melalui sarana media elektronik lainnya yang memungkinkan semua peserta rapat Dewan Komisaris saling melihat dan mendengar secara langsung serta berpartisipasi dalam rapat Dewan Komisaris.
38. Ensuring that the on-schedule audit schedule is in accordance with what has been determined, but remains dynamic and flexible; 39. Ensuring that testing of internal controls is carried out by referring to the Internal Control Over Financial Report (ICOFR); 40. Conducting e-audit development and preparing guidelines for managing audit source data; 41. Conducting cyber-attack trials to detect data security levels; 42. Implementing AI technology; 43. Conducting penetration tests on all lines from downstream to upstream to check for IT system gaps that may be entered by irresponsible people; 44. Conducting a more realistic RKA preparation by looking at market conditions; 45. Improving budget preparation guidelines; 46. Integrating into SAP applications; 47. Conducting digitalization to reduce workload; 48. Conducting evaluation of AU guidance and supervision guidelines; 49. Conducting a review of subsidiary performance; and 50. Anticipating and conducting dissemination of the implementation of the Minister of Finance Regulation (PMK) which will come into effect in 2025.
Board of Commissioners Meeting Board of Commissioners Meeting Policy As stipulated in the Joint Decision of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors of PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) No. 010 of 2024 and No. 053 of 2024 on the Work Guidelines for the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors (Board Manual), Board of Commissioners meetings are held periodically at least once a month or can be held at any time according to needs. The Board of Commissioners meeting is assisted by the Secretary to the Board of Commissioners to record the minutes of the meeting.
In the meeting, the Board of Commissioners may invite the Board of Directors. Board of Commissioners meetings are held at the Corporation’s domicile or the Corporation’s place of business activities. Board of Commissioners meetings can also be held via teleconference, video conference, or through other electronic media that allow all participants in the Board of Commissioners meeting to see and hear each other directly and participate in the Board of Commissioners meeting.

326 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Pelatihan dan/atau Peningkatan Kompetensi Anggota Dewan Komisaris Kebijakan Pelatihan dan/atau Peningkatan Kompetensi Anggota Dewan Komisaris Perseroan memiliki kebijakan terkait peningkatan kapabilitas sebagaimana diatur dalam Keputusan Bersama Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) No. 010 Tahun 2024 dan No. 053 Tahun 2024 tentang Pedoman Kerja Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi (Board Manual). Program peningkatan kapabilitas merupakan program penting agar Dewan Komisaris dapat selalu memperbarui informasi tentang perkembangan terkini dari aktivitas bisnis Perseroan dan pengetahuan-pengetahuan lain yang terkait dengan pelaksanaan tugas Dewan Komisaris. Ketentuan-ketentuan tentang program peningkatan kapabilitas bagi Dewan Komisaris adalah sebagai berikut: 1. Program peningkatan kapabilitas dilaksanakan dalam rangka meningkatkan efektivitas kerja Dewan Komisaris; 2. Program peningkatan kapabilitas wajib dilakukan dengan pilihan salah satu atau lebih dari topik pelatihan berikut: manajemen risiko, fraud, bisnis, kegiatan usaha korporasi, hukum, kepatuhan, keuangan, akuntansi, audit dan manajemen keberlangsungan usaha (business continuity management); 3. Rencana untuk melaksanakan program peningkatan kapabilitas harus dimasukkan dalam Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Tahunan Dewan Komisaris; 4. Setiap anggota Dewan Komisaris yang mengikuti program peningkatan kapabilitas seperti seminar dan/atau pelatihan diminta untuk memaparkan kepada Komisaris Utama dan Anggota Dewan Komisaris lainnya dalam rangka mendiskusikan relevansinya untuk dilaksanakan di Perseroan; dan 5. Dewan Komisaris membuat laporan tertulis triwulanan yang didalamnya termasuk tentang pelaksanaan program peningkatan kapabilitas. Laporan tertulis tersebut disampaikan kepada Pemegang Saham.
Program Pengenalan Dewan Komisaris Perseroan memiliki kebijakan terkait program pengenalan Dewan Komisaris sebagaimana diatur dalam Keputusan Bersama Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) No. 010 Tahun 2024 dan No. 053 Tahun 2024 tentang Pedoman Kerja Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi (Board Manual). Program pengenalan mengenai Perseroan wajib diberikan kepada anggota Dewan Komisaris yang baru pertama kali menjabat sebagai Dewan Komisaris di Perseroan. Program pengenalan dapat disampaikan oleh Komisaris Utama atau Komisaris Utama berhalangan, maka dapat disampaikan Training and/or Competency Development of the Board of Commissioners’ Members Policy on Training and/or Competency Development of Board of Commissioners’ Members The Corporation has a policy related to capability development as stipulated in the Joint Decision of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors of PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) No. 010 of 2024 and No. 053 of 2024 on the Work Guidelines for the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors (Board Manual). The capability development program is an important program so that the Board of Commissioners can always update information on the latest developments in the Corporation’s business activities and other knowledge related to the implementation of the Board of Commissioners’ duties. The provisions on the capability development program for the Board of Commissioners are as follows: 1. The capability development program is implemented in order to improve the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners’ work; 2. The capability development program must be carried out with a choice of one or more of the following training topics: risk management, fraud, business, corporate business activities, law, compliance, finance, accounting, audit and business continuity management; 3. The plan to implement the capability development program must be included in the Board of Commissioners’ Annual Work Plan and Budget; 4. Each member of the Board of Commissioners who participates in a capability development program such as a seminar and/or training is requested to present to the President Commissioner and other members of the Board of Commissioners in order to discuss its relevance to be implemented in the Corporation; and 5. The Board of Commissioners prepares a quarterly written report which includes the implementation of the capability development program. The written report is submitted to the Shareholders.
Board of Commissioners Introduction Program The Corporation has a policy related to the Board of Commissioners introduction program as stipulated in the Joint Decision of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors of PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) No. 010 of 2024 and No. 053 of 2024 on the Work Guidelines for the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors (Board Manual). The introduction program regarding the Corporation must be provided to members of the Board of Commissioners who are serving as Board Commissioners in the Corporation for the first time. The introduction program can be delivered by the President 327 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report oleh Direktur Utama atau dapat dilakukan oleh Corporate Secretary.
Materi yang diberikan pada program pengenalan meliputi hal-hal sebagai berikut: 1. Pelaksanaan Good Corporate Governance di lingkungan Perseroan; 2. Gambaran mengenai Perseroan berkaitan dengan visi dan misi, nilai-nilai Perseroan, tujuan dan strategi Perseroan, lingkup kegiatan Perseroan, kinerja keuangan dan operasi, rencana usaha jangka pendek dan jangka panjang, manajemen risiko, dan masalah-masalah strategis lainnya; 3. Pengenalan mengenai berbagai peraturan yang berhubungan dengan pekerjaan Direksi seperti peraturan mengenai Perseroan Terbatas, peraturan mengenai Tindak Pidana Korupsi, peraturan mengenai Persaingan Usaha, dan peraturan lain yang dirasa relevan; 4. Penjelasan yang berkaitan dengan kewenangan yang didelegasikan, audit internal dan eksternal, sistem dan kebijakan pengendalian internal serta tugas dan peran Komite Audit dan komite Dewan Komisaris lainnya; 5. Penjelasan mengenai tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi serta Komite Dewan Komisaris; dan 6. Penjelasan mengenai tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi serta Komite Dewan Komisaris.
Program pengenalan tersebut dapat dilaksanakan dalam bentuk presentasi/seminar/workshop, pertemuan, kunjungan ke lokasi, pengkajian dokumen atau bentuk lainnya yang dianggap sesuai.
Pada tahun 2024, Perseroan mengadakan program pengenalan kepada Deni Surjantoro sebagai Komisaris pada tanggal 7 November 2024 dan Heru Budi Hartono pada tanggal 14 November 2024. Agenda program pengenalan adalah sebagai berikut: 1. Overview PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda); 2. Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan Organ Pendukungnya; 3. Penghargaan (Award), RJPP , dan Highlights Capaian Kinerja Perseroan; dan 4. Struktur dan Peran GRC Terintegrasi.
Program Pelatihan dan/atau Peningkatan Kompetensi Dewan Komisaris Pada tahun 2024, program Pelatihan dan/atau Peningkatan Kompetensi Anggota Dewan Komisaris yang diikuti oleh Dewan Komisaris Perseroan adalah sebagai berikut: Commissioner or if the President Commissioner is unable to attend, it can be delivered by the President Director or can be carried out by the Corporate Secretary.
The materials provided in the introduction program include the following matters: 1. Implementation of Good Corporate Governance within the Corporation; 2. Description of the Corporation relating to the vision and mission, values of the Corporation, objectives and strategies of the Corporation, scope of activities of the Corporation, financial and operational performance, short-term, and long-term business plans, risk management and other strategic issues; 3. Introduction to various regulations relating to the work of the Board of Directors such as regulations on Limited Liability Companies, regulations on Corruption Crimes, regulations on Business Competition, and other regulations deemed relevant; 4. Explanation relating to delegated authority, internal and external audits, internal control systems and policies as well as the duties and roles of the Audit Committee and other committees of the Board of Commissioners; 5. Explanation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors as well as the Committees of the Board of Commissioners; and 6. Explanation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors as well as the Committees of the Board of Commissioners.
The introduction program can be implemented in the form of presentations/seminars/workshops, meetings, site visits, document reviews or other forms deemed appropriate.
In 2024, the Corporation held an introduction program for Deni Surjantoro as Commissioner on November 7, 2024 and Heru Budi Hartono on November 14, 2024. The agenda of the introduction program is as follows: 1. Overview of PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda); 2. Duties and Responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners, Board of Directors, and Supporting Organs; 3. Awards, RJPP , and Highlights of the Corporation’s Performance Achievements; and 4. Structure and Role of Integrated GRC.

Penilaian Kinerja Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris Penilaian Kinerja Direksi Prosedur Pelaksanaan Penilaian Kinerja Direksi dan Pihak yang Melakukan Penilaian Penilaian dan evaluasi KPI Korporasi PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) Tahun 2024 dilaksanakan oleh Badan Pembinaan BUMD dan/atau pihak ketiga yang berkompeten yang ditunjuk, dan hasil penilaian dan evaluasi disampaikan kepada Gubernur dan/atau RUPS/RUPS-LB. Penilaian kinerja masing-masing anggota Direksi dilakukan secara self-assessment. Self-assessment berfungsi untuk menilai efektivitas kinerja Direksi dibandingkan penilaian KPI di kontrak manajemen. Prosedur dan tata cara self-assessment Direksi meliputi: Performance Assessment of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners Performance Assessment of the Board of Directors Procedure for Implementing the Performance Assessment of the Board of Directors and the Party Conducting the Assessment The assessment and evaluation of the Corporate KPI of PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) in 2024 was carried out by BUMD Development Agency and/or a competent third party appointed, and the results of the assessment and evaluation are submitted to the Governor and/or GMS/EGMS.
The performance assessment of each member of the Board of Directors is carried out by self-assessment. Self-assessment functions to assess the effectiveness of the Board of Directors’ performance compared to the KPI assessment in the management contract. The procedures and methods for the Board of Directors’ self-assessment include: 329 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report 1. Metode Penilaian Self-assessment dilakukan oleh Direksi dengan menggunakan formulir self-assessment.
2. Kriteria Penilaian Formulir self-assessment adalah yang telah sesuai dengan tugas dan kewajiban Direksi pada Surat Keputusan Organisasi.
3. Waktu Pelaksanaan Direksi wajib melakukan self-assessment minimal 1 kali dalam 1 tahun.
4. Pihak yang Melakukan Penilaian Pihak yang melakukan penilaian terhadap kinerja Direksi adalah Direksi itu sendiri, melalui self-assessment, kemudian hasilnya dievaluasi oleh Dewan Komisaris melalui rapat berdasarkan rekomendasi dari Komite Tata Kelola dan Keberlanjutan.
Kriteria Penilaian KPI Direksi Kriteria evaluasi kinerja Direksi berdasarkan KPI Korporasi dibagi ke dalam beberapa perspektif, yaitu: 1. Financial; 2. Customer; 3. Internal Business Process; dan 4. Learning & Growth.
Kriteria evaluasi kinerja masing-masing Direksi dicantumkan dalam KPI Direktorat yang menggambarkan secara lebih detail tugas dan tanggung jawab Direktorat dalam mendukung KPI Korporasi.
Hasil Penilaian KPI Direksi Tahun 2024 Dari hasil evaluasi pada tahun 2024 yang dilakukan Dewan Komisaris dan dilaporkan kepada pemegang saham, diketahui Direksi memperlihatkan kinerja yang baik dalam mengurus Perseroan. Direksi dapat merealisasikan target-target yang telah ditetapkan dalam Kontrak Manajemen yang telah ditandatangani.
Kontrak Manajemen tahun 2024 telah disepakati Bersama dengan pemegang saham pada tanggal 30 November 2023.
Hasil KPI Korporasi PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) Berdasarkan capaian selama satu tahun terakhir yang telah dilakukan, MRT Jakarta tetap bisa mempertahankan capaian KPI Korporasinya diatas 100% yaitu dengan capaian 101,20%, di mana perspektif customer berhasil melampaui target yang telah ditentukan. Adapun masing-masing direktur memiliki capaian yang berbeda sesuai dengan KPI Direktoratnya.
1. Assessment Method Self-assessment is carried out by the Board of Directors using the self-assessment form.
2. Assessment Criteria The self-assessment form is one that is in accordance with the duties and obligations of the Board of Directors in the Organizational Decision.
3. Implementation Time The Board of Directors is required to conduct a self-assessment at least once a year.
4. Parties Conducting Assessments The parties conducting assessments of the Board of Directors’ performance are the Board of Directors themselves, through self-assessment, then the results are evaluated by the Board of Commissioners through a meeting based on recommendations from the Governance and Sustainability Committee.
Board of Directors’ KPI Assessment Criteria The performance evaluation criteria for the Board of Directors based on the Corporate KPI are divided into several perspectives, as follows: 1. Financial; 2. Customer; 3. Internal Business Process; and 4. Learning & Growth.
The performance evaluation criteria for each Director are listed in the Directorate KPI, which describes in more detail the Directorate’s duties and responsibilities in supporting the Corporate KPI.
Board of Directors’ KPI Assessment Results in 2024 From the evaluation results in 2024 conducted by the Board of Commissioners and reported to shareholders, the Board of Directors has shown good performance in managing the Corporation. The Board of Directors can realize the targets set in the signed Management Contract.
The 2024 Management Contract was agreed upon together with shareholders on November 30, 2023.

Each director made different achievements in line with the respective Directorate’s KPI.

Pemegang Saham menetapkan indikator Pencapaian Kinerja (Key Performance Indicator) Dewan Komisaris berdasarkan usulan dari Dewan Komisaris yang dimuat dalam Kontrak Manajemen. Dewan Komisaris wajib menyampaikan laporan triwulanan realisasi kinerja kepada Pemegang Saham. Pemegang Saham menilai kinerja Dewan Komisaris secara keseluruhan.
Dewan Komisaris membuat kebijakan penilaian sendiri (self assessment) untuk menilai kinerja sebagai Dewan secara keseluruhan. Kebijakan penilaian sendiri atau kebijakan penilaian lainnya didasarkan pada tolok ukur atau kriteria penilaian yang spesifik, terukur, dapat dicapai, dan relevan serta sesuai dengan yang ditetapkan Dewan Komisaris. Dewan Komisaris melakukan penilaian independent secara berkala melibatkan pihak ketiga. Hasil evaluasi kinerja masing-masing Anggota Dewan Komisaris secara individual merupakan salah satu dasar pertimbangan bagi Pemegang Saham untuk memberhentikan dan/atau menunjuk kembali Anggota Dewan Komisaris yang bersangkutan. Hasil evaluasi kinerja tersebut merupakan sarana penilaian serta peningkatan efektivitas Dewan Komisaris.
Board of Commissioners’ Performance Assessment Procedure for Implementing the Board of Commissioners’ Performance Assessment and the Parties Conducting the Assessment The performance of the Board of Commissioners’ Members is assessed and evaluated annually and/ or at any time according to the Corporation’s needs and/or the Corporation’s management policies. Shareholders determine the Board of Commissioners’ Key Performance Indicators based on proposals from the Board of Commissioners contained in the Management Contract. The Board of Commissioners is required to submit quarterly reports on performance realization to Shareholders. Shareholders assess the performance of the Board of Commissioners as a whole.
The Board of Commissioners creates a self-assessment policy to assess performance as a Board as a whole. The self-assessment policy or other assessment policies are based on specific, measurable, achievable, and relevant benchmarks or assessment criteria and in accordance with those determined by the Board of Commissioners. The Board of Commissioners conducts independent assessments periodically involving third parties. The performance evaluation results of each Member of the Board of Commissioners individually are one of the basic considerations for Shareholders to dismiss and/ or reappoint the Member of the Board of Commissioners concerned. The performance evaluation results are a means of assessing and increasing the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners.

Keterlibatannya dalam penugasan-penugasan tertentu; 5. Komitmennya dalam memajukan kepentingan Perseroan; dan 6. Ketaatan terhadap peraturan-peraturan yang berlaku, Anggaran Dasar Perseroan, ketentuan RUPS, serta kebijakan Perseroan.

Solutions provided to problems faced in the field of work and their impact, both on the related Work Unit and the Corporation.

Dewan Komisaris melakukan Site Visit Board of Commissioners conducts a Site Visit 339 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report 340 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Direksi merupakan organ Perseroan yang memiliki tanggung jawab untuk memastikan seluruh aktivitas pengelolaan MRT Jakarta berjalan secara efisien dan efektif serta sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip Governansi. Direksi menjalankan segala tindakan yang berkaitan dengan pengurusan MRT Jakarta sesuai dengan maksud dan tujuannya baik di dalam maupun di luar pengadilan tentang segala hal dan segala kejadian dengan pembatasan-pembatasan diatur dalam peraturan perundang-undangan, Anggaran Dasar, dan Keputusan RUPS. Ketentuan Masa Jabatan Direksi Mengacu pada Anggaran Dasar Perseroan, anggota Direksi diangkat oleh RUPS setelah melaksanakan uji kelayakan dan kepatutan, untuk jangka waktu 5 tahun dengan tidak mengurangi hak RUPS untuk memberhentikannya sewaktu-waktu.
Direksi Board of Directors The Board of Directors is an organ of the Corporation that has the responsibility to ensure that all MRT Jakarta management activities run efficiently and effectively and in accordance with the principles of Governance. The Board of Directors carries out all actions related to the management of MRT Jakarta in accordance with its purpose and objectives both inside and outside the court on all matters and all events with restrictions stipulated in the laws and regulations, Articles of Association, and GMS Resolutions.
Terms of Office of the Board of Directors Pursuant to the Corporation's Articles of Association, members of the Board of Directors are appointed by the GMS after conducting a fit and proper test, for a period of 5 years without prejudice to the GMS right to dismiss them at any time.
