• Master of Business Administration (MBA) at Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (2009); • Masters (S2) of the Faculty of Public Health, Universitas Indonesia (2003); and • Bachelor (S1) of the Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Airlangga (1998).
Internal Audit Unit The Internal Audit Division is the Internal Supervisory Unit (SPI) or work unit that carries out the internal audit function. Internal Audit is an independent and objective assurance and consulting activity, designed to provide added value and improve the organization's operations. Internal Audit helps the organization to achieve its objectives, through a systematic and regular approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk management, internal control and governance processes. Legal basis for the establishment of Internal Audit Division are as follows: 1. Law No. 23 of 2014 on Regional Government, Article 343 which regulates the need for establishment of an Audit Committee and Internal Audit at BUMD; and 2. Decree of the Governor of DKI Jakarta Province No. 96 of 2004 dated October 7, 2004 on the Implementation of Good Corporate Governance Practices in Regional-Owned Enterprises (BUMD) within DKI Jakarta Provincial Government.
Appointment and Dismissal of the Head of Internal Audit Division The Head of Internal Audit Division is appointed and dismissed by the President Director with the approval of the Board of Commissioners.

674 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Hubungan Kerja dan Koordinasi Untuk menjamin efektifitas dan efisiensi pelaksanaan tugas, perlu terjalin hubungan kerja dan koordinasi yang baik antara Divisi Internal Audit dengan unit-unit kerja dan pihak-pihak yang terkait, sebagai berikut: 1. Divisi Internal Audit dan Direktur Utama a. Direktur Utama memastikan bahwa Divisi Internal Audit dapat melaksanakan penugasan secara independen, objektif dan bebas dari benturan kepentingan dari pihak mana pun; b. Divisi Internal Audit harus melaporkan kepada Direktur Utama, jika klien yang bersangkutan memutuskan untuk tidak mengikuti saran tindak lanjut atas dasar suatu pertimbangan tertentu; dan c. Direktur Utama memberikan dukungan atas pelaksanaan penugasan, dalam bentuk sumber daya manusia, anggaran, infrastruktur, teknologi, ataupun hal-hal lain yang dibutuhkan kemudian. 2. Divisi Internal Audit dan Dewan Komisaris/Komite Audit a. Divisi Internal Audit menyampaikan salinan laporan penugasan kepada Dewan Komisaris/ Komite Audit atas setiap penugasan yang dilaksanakan; b. Pelaksanaan rapat koordinasi secara berkala antara Divisi Internal Audit dan Dewan Komisaris/Komite Audit; dan c. Apabila dipandang perlu, Dewan Komisaris/ Komite Audit dapat meminta Divisi Internal Audit untuk memberikan informasi, dalam rangka pelaksanaan fungsi pengawasan oleh Dewan Komisaris Komite Audit. 3. Divisi Internal Audit dan Komite Komisaris lainnya a. Hubungan kerja Divisi Internal Audit dengan Komite Komisaris lainnya pada dasarnya dilakukan melalui Direktur Utama dan Komite Audit; dan b. Apabila dipandang perlu, melakukan rapat koordinasi antara Divisi Internal Audit, Direktur Utama, Komite Audit, dan Komite Komisaris lain, misalnya untuk membahas informasi terkini yang dapat berdampak pada perusahaan, best practice dalam pengendalian internal, dan lain-lain. 4. Divisi Internal Audit dan Klien a. Unit kerja dan fungsi bisnis perusahaan (Klien) memberikan dan menyajikan informasi yang relevan dengan ruang lingkup penugasan; b. Klien melaporkan tindak lanjut dan status atas setiap rekomendasi kepada Divisi Internal Audit sesuai dengan prosedur dan mekanisme yang berlaku; Working Relationship and Coordination To ensure the effectiveness and efficiency of implementation of duties, it is necessary to establish good working relationships and coordination between the Internal Audit Division with work units and related parties, as follows: 1. Internal Audit Division and President Director a. The President Director ensures that the Internal Audit Division can carry out its assignments independently, objectively and free from conflicts of interest from any party; b. The Internal Audit Division must report to the President Director, if the client concerned decides not to follow the follow-up advice on the basis of a certain consideration; and c. The President Director provides support for the implementation of the assignment, in the form of human resources, budget, infrastructure, technology, or other matters required later.
2. Internal Audit Division and Board of Commissioners/ Audit Committee a. The Internal Audit Division submits a copy of the assignment report to the Board of Commissioners/Audit Committee for each assignment carried out; b. Periodic coordination meetings between the Internal Audit Division and the Board of Commissioners/Audit Committee; and c. If deemed necessary, the Board of Commissioners/ Audit Committee may request the Internal Audit Division to provide information, in the context of implementing the supervisory function by the Board of Commissioners/Audit Committee.
3. Internal Audit Division and other Commissioners’ Committees a. The working relationship between the Internal Audit Division and other Committees of Commissioners is basically conducted through the President Director and the Audit Committee; and b. If deemed necessary, conduct coordination meetings between the Internal Audit Division, President Director, Audit Committee, and other Committees of Commissioners, for example to discuss the latest information that can have an impact on the Corporation, best practices in internal control, and others.
4. Internal Audit Division and Clients a. Work units and business functions of the Corporation (Clients) provide and present information relevant to the scope of the assignment; b. The client reports the follow-up and status of each recommendation to the Internal Audit Division in accordance with the applicable procedures and mechanisms; 675 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report c. Dalam hal terjadi perbedaan pendapat antara Auditor dan Klien mengenai hasil observasi dan kesimpulan hasil penugasan, maka perbedaan pendapat ini harus diungkapkan dalam laporan; dan d. Apabila dipandang perlu, Klien dapat memberikan dukungan atas suatu penugasan yang dilakukan ke pihak ketiga (eksternal perusahaan). 5. Divisi Internal Audit dan Divisi Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance a. Melakukan koordinasi secara rutin untuk memastikan bahwa penugasan yang dilakukan oleh Divisi Internal Audit relevan dan selaras dengan profil risiko organisasi. b. Divisi Internal Audit memberikan informasi atas hasil pengelolaan risiko dan pengendalian internal yang dilakukan oleh lini pertama, agar dapat mempertajam analisa risiko. c. Melakukan kerjasama dalam rangka pengembangan kompetensi Auditor dan Risk Analis. 6. Divisi Internal Audit dan Auditor Eksternal a. Auditor Eksternal melaksanakan pemeriksaan terhadap proses dan fungsi bisnis perusahaan sesuai dengan ketentuan perundang-undangan yang berlaku atau berdasarkan penugasan dari perusahaan; b. Divisi Internal Audit menjadi mitra pendamping bagi Auditor Eksternal selama pelaksanaan penugasan, baik sebagai penyedia data/ informasi maupun pada saat pembahasan/ konfirmasi hasil audit; c. Divisi Internal Audit dapat mempertimbangkan lingkup penugasan Auditor Eksternal untuk mengurangi duplikasi lingkup penugasannya; dan d. Tindak lanjut dan status atas setiap rekomendasi audit yang disampaikan Auditor Eksternal merupakan bahan pengawasan Divisi Internal Audit.
Tanggung Jawab Internal Audit 1. Mengelola kegiatan pengawasan melalui berbagai kegiatan asuransi berbasis risiko dan konsultansi bagi seluruh unit kerja di Perseroan dan pihak terafiliasi agar dapat memenuhi mandatnya; 2. Menguji dan mengevaluasi pelaksanaan pengendalian internal, sistem manajemen risiko, penerapan tata kelola perseroan yang baik serta kepatuhan sesuai dengan kebijakan perusahaan; 3. Menyusun perencanaan berbasis risiko untuk menetapkan priorias kegiatan aktivitas audit internal sesuai dengan tujuan Perseroan. Rencana Kerja dan Audit Tahunan beserta dengan anggaran biayanya, disampaikan untuk mendapatkan persetujuan c. In the event of a difference of opinion between the Auditor and the Client regarding the observations and conclusions of the assignment results, this difference of opinion must be disclosed in the report; and d. If deemed necessary, the Client can provide support for an assignment carried out by a third party (external to the corporation).
5. Internal Audit Division and Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Division a. Coordinate regularly to ensure that the assignments performed by the Internal Audit Division are relevant and aligned with the organization’s risk profile.
b. The Internal Audit Division provides information on the results of risk management and internal control carried out by the first line, in order to sharpen the risk analysis.
c. Cooperate in order to develop the competence of Auditors and Risk Analysts.
6. Internal Audit Division and External Auditor a. External Auditors carry out examinations of the corporation’s business processes and functions in accordance with applicable laws and regulations or based on assignments from the corporation; b. The Internal Audit Division becomes a partner for the External Auditor during the implementation of the assignment, both as a provider of data/information and during the discussion/ confirmation of audit results; c. The Internal Audit Division may consider the scope of the External Auditor’s assignment to reduce duplication of the scope of the assignment; and d. The follow-up and status of each audit recommendation submitted by the External Auditor is a supervisory material for the Internal Audit Division.
Internal Audit Responsibilities 1. Managing supervisory activities through various risk-based insurance and consultancy activities for all work units in the Corporation and affiliated parties in order to fulfill its mandate; 2. Testing and evaluating the implementation of internal control, risk management systems, implementation of good corporate governance and compliance in accordance with corporation policies; 3. Developing risk-based planning to determine the priority of internal audit activities in accordance with the Corporation’s objectives. The Annual Work and Audit Plan along with the budget, is submitted for approval by the President Director and submitted 676 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Direktur Utama dan disampaikan kepada Dewan Komisaris melalui Komite Audit untuk mendapatkan pertimbangan dan saran; 4. Melakukan jasa asurans dan konsultansi untuk menguji efektivitas dan efisiensi di bidang keuangan, akuntansi, konstruksi, operasional dan perawatan, manajemen risiko, sumber daya manusia, pengembangan bisnis, teknologi informasi, dan kegiatan lainnya; 5. Melaporkan temuan yang signifikan kepada Direktur Utama dan Dewan Komisaris untuk dilakukan tindakan perbaikan dalam waktu yang cepat, serta membuat Laporan Hasil Audit (LHA) dan menyampaikan laporan tersebut kepada Direktur Utama dan Dewan Komisaris; 6. Memantau, menganalisis, dan melaporkan pelaksanaan tindak lanjut perbaikan yang telah direkomendasikan dan disepakati kepada Direktur Utama dan Dewan Komisaris; 7. Memberikan saran perbaikan dan informasi yang objektif tentang kegiatan/area yang diperiksa pada semua tingkatan manajemen; 8. Menyusun program untuk mengevaluasi mutu kegiatan Divisi Internal Audit; 9. Bekerja sama dengan Komite Audit; 10. Melaksanakan audit khusus/audit dengan tujuan tertentu atas informasi dari Whistleblowing System (WBS) sebagai bagian dari penerapan ISO 37001:2016, Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuapan (SMAP) maupun penugasan lainnya yang ditugaskan oleh Direktur Utama atau Dewan Komisaris. Kemudian melaporkan hasilnya sesuai dengan ketentuan yang diatur oleh Kebijakan Perseroan; 11. Melakukan koordinasi pengawasan dengan penyedia asurans eksternal (misalnya: Kantor Akuntan Publik, Investigator dan Auditor Eksternal Penilai Penerapan Sistem Manajemen) dalam rangka penerapan combined assurance; 12. Memastikan pelaksanaan fungsi pengawasan internal sesuai dengan standar profesional Audit Internal dan kode etik Audit Internal; 13. Bekerja sama dengan fungsi lain dalam Perseroan, Divisi Internal Audit membangun budaya risk and control awareness untuk seluruh karyawan dalam Perseroan; dan 14. Melakukan penugasan lain yang diamanatkan oleh Direksi dan/atau Dewan Komisaris selama tidak berdampak pada pelemahan terhadap Independensi dan Objektivitas Auditor Internal.
Wewenang Internal Audit 1. Menjalankan penugasan pada semua area dan kegiatan operasional serta bisnis Perseroan, termasuk anak perusahaan, pihak terafiliasi, mitra strategis, penyedia barang dan jasa, serta pihak lain yang relevan, sesuai dengan tata kelola yang berlaku; to the Board of Commissioners through the Audit Committee for consideration and advice; 4. Performing assurance and consultancy services to test effectiveness and efficiency in finance, accounting, construction, operations and maintenance, risk management, human resources, business development, information technology, and other activities; 5. Reporting significant findings to the President Director and the Board of Commissioners for corrective action in a timely manner, preparing an Audit Report (LHA) and submitting the report to the President Director and the Board of Commissioners; 6. Monitoring, analyzing, and reporting the implementation of recommended and agreed corrective actions to the President Director and Board of Commissioners; 7. Providing suggestions for improvement and objective information about the activities/areas examined at all levels of management; 8. Developing a program to evaluate the quality of the Internal Audit Division’s activities; 9. Cooperate with the Audit Committee; 10. Carrying out special audits/audits with specific objectives on information from the Whistleblowing System (WBS) as part of the implementation of ISO 37001:2016, Anti-Bribery Management System (SMAP) and other assignments assigned by the President Director or the Board of Commissioners. Report the results in accordance with the provisions stipulated by the Corporation Policy; 11. Coordinating supervision with external assurance providers (eg: Public Accounting Firm, Investigator and External Auditor of Management System Implementation Assessment) in order to implement combined assurance; 12. Ensuring the implementation of the internal control function in accordance with the Internal Audit professional standards and the Internal Audit code of ethics; 13. Cooperating with other functions in the Corporation, the Internal Audit Division builds a culture of risk and control awareness for all employees in the Corporation; and 14. Performing other assignments mandated by the Board of Directors and/or the Board of Commissioners as long as it does not have an impact on weakening the Independence and Objectivity of the Internal Auditor.
Internal Audit Authority 1. Carrying out assignments in all areas, operational activities, the Corporation’s business, including subsidiaries, affiliated parties, strategic partners, providers of goods and services, and other relevant parties, in accordance with applicable governance; 677 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report 2. Memiliki akses tidak terbatas atas semua data, informasi, dokumen, kegiatan, serta akses terhadap personel dan aset Perseroan yang diperlukan dalam rangka pelaksanaan tugas; 3. Melakukan komunikasi secara langsung dengan Direksi, Direktur, Dewan Komisaris, dan Komite Audit; 4. Mengadakan rapat secara berkala dan insidentil dengan Direksi, Direktur, Dewan Komisaris, dan Komite Audit; 5. Melakukan pemilihan sumber daya manusia yang kompeten sesuai dengan kebutuhan dalam pelaksanaan penugasan Audit Internal, dan memastikan Auditor Internal mengikuti pengembangan profesional berkelanjutan serta pelatihan lain sesuai dengan perkembangan kompleksitas dan kegiatan Perseroan; 6. Mendapatkan dukungan penuh dari Perseroan berupa perangkat kerja berbasis Teknologi Informasi, software aplikasi, akses informasi kepada data primer Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) yang digunakan oleh Perseroan maupun fasilitas penunjang lainnya yang diperlukan untuk pelaksanaan penugasan; 7. Dalam rangka pelaksanaan tugasnya, dapat meminta atau mendapatkan bantuan dari pihak internal Perseroan sebagai subject matter expert maupun eksternal Perseroan, dengan mempertimbangkan kompetensi yang dimiliki Auditor Internal, tingkat urgensi, dan kerahasiaan data serta mematuhi piagam Audit Internal Perseroan; 8. Menyusun strategi pelaksanaan Audit Internal anak perusahaan dan merekomendasikan penyelarasan strategi Audit Internal terhadap Usaha Patungan; dan 9. Mengelola kegiatan koordinasi dan pengawasan atas anak Perseroan dan pihak-pihak terafiliasi.
Divisi Internal Audit tidak berwenang untuk menjabat/ rangkap jabatan/mengambil alih tanggung jawab sebagai pelaksana, dalam kegiatan operasional perusahaan maupun anak perusahaan dan/atau perusahaan patungan.
Piagam Audit Internal Perseroan telah memiliki Piagam Audit Internal yang ditinjau dan diperbaharui secara berkala. Piagam Audit Internal disusun untuk menjadi norma-norma acuan kerja bagi Divisi Internal Audit sesuai tujuan penugasannya. Piagam Audit Internal telah diperbaharui pada 30 November 2022, dan berisi: 1. Kedudukan dan Fungsi Internal Audit; 2. Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Divisi Internal Audit; 3. Wewenang Divisi Internal Audit; 4. Lingkup Kerja Divisi Internal Audit; 2. Having unrestricted access to all data, information, documents, activities, as well as access to the Corporation’s personnel and assets required in the performance of duties; 3. Communicating directly with the Board of Directors, Directors, Board of Commissioners, and Audit Committee; 4. Holding regular and incidental meetings with the Board of Directors, Directors, Board of Commissioners, and Audit Committee; 5. Selecting competent human resources according to the needs in the implementation of Internal Audit assignments and ensuring that Internal Auditors, follow continuous professional development and other training in accordance with the development of the Corporation’s complexity and activities; 6. Receiving full support from the Corporation in the form of Information Technology-based work tools, software - applications, access to information to the primary data of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) used by the Corporation and other supporting facilities needed for the implementation of the assignment; 7. In order to carry out its duties, may request or obtain assistance from internal parties of the Corporation as subject matter experts and external parties of the Corporation, taking into account the competence of the Internal Auditors, the level of urgency, and confidentiality of data and comply with the Corporation’s Internal Audit Charter; 8. Preparing strategies for the implementation of Internal Audit of Subsidiaries and recommending the alignment of Internal Audit strategies to Joint Ventures; and 9. Managing coordination and supervision activities over the Corporation’s subsidiaries and affiliated parties.
The Internal Audit Division is not authorized to serve/ double positions/take over responsibilities as executors, in the operational activities of the corporation and its subsidiaries and / or joint ventures.
Internal Audit Charter The Corporation has an Internal Audit Charter that is reviewed and updated regularly. The Internal Audit Charter is prepared to become the norms of work reference for the Internal Audit Division in accordance with the objectives of its assignment. The Internal Audit Charter has been updated on November 30, 2022, and contains: 1. Position and Function of Internal Audit; 2. Duties and Responsibilities of the Internal Audit Division; 3. Authority of the Internal Audit Division; 4. Scope of Work of the Internal Audit Division; 678 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance 5. Hubungan Kerja dan Koordinasi; 6. Standar Audit Internal; dan 7. Program Asurans dan Peningkatan Kualitas.

Sepanjang tahun 2024 Divisi Internal Audit menghadiri 17 kali rapat dengan Direksi, 12 kali pada rapat gabungan Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi, dan 12 kali rapat dengan Komite Audit & Kepatuhan. Pembahasan yang dilakukan dalam rapat, antara lain mengenai Realisasi Rencana Kerja dan Audit Tahunan (RKAT) 2024, Rencana RKAT 2025, Tindak Lanjut Hasil Audit Internal dan Eksternal, Kerangka Acuan Kerja (KAK) Pengadaan Jasa Audit KAP tahun buku 2024, serta usulan anggaran Divisi Internal Audit tahun 2025.
Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Direksi membentuk Divisi Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance dalam rangka Memastikan implementasi Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance secara terintegrasi (GRC Terintegrasi), Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuapan (SMAP), Sistem Manajemen Kepatuhan (SMK), Business Continuity Management (BCM) serta sistem manajemen yang terkait aspek Quality, Safety, Security, Health, and Environment (QSSHE) berjalan dengan baik, guna mencegah terjadinya risiko Perseroan yang berdampak pada keberlangsungan usaha, reputasi Perseroan, pencapaian sasaran Perseroan, pelanggaran terhadap hukum dan/atau norma ketentuan Perseroan. Dalam menjalankan tugasnya, Divisi Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance mempunyai hubungan kerja langsung dengan Direksi dan Komite GRC Terintegrasi.
Throughout 2024, the Internal Audit Division attended 17 meetings with the Board of Directors, 12 joint meetings with the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors, and 12 meetings with the Audit & Compliance Committee. The meetings discussed, among others, the Realization of the 2024 Annual Work and Audit Plan (RKAT), the 2025 RKAT Plan, Follow-up of Internal and External Audit Results, Terms of Reference (KAK) for the Procurement of KAP Audit Services for the 2024 fiscal year, as well as the proposed budget for the Internal Audit Division in 2025.
Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance The Board of Directors established the Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Division in order to ensure the implementation of integrated Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance (Integrated GRC), Anti-Bribery Management System (SMAP), Compliance Management System (SMK), Business Continuity Management (BCM) and management systems related to Quality, Safety, Security, Health, and Environment (QSSHE) aspects run well, in order to prevent the occurrence of the Corporation’s risks that have an impact on business continuity, the Corporation’s reputation, achievement of the Corporation’s goals, violation of the law and/or norms of the Corporation’s provisions. DEPARTEMEN ENTERPRISE RISK MANAGEMENT & COMPLIANCE ENTERPRISE RISK MANAGEMENT & COMPLIANCE DEPARTMENT Kegiatan Activities 1 Memastikan terlaksananya proses asesmen risiko dan pemenuhan kewajiban kepatuhan di unit kerja sesuai dengan kebijakan, pedoman dan prosedur yang berlaku di Perseroan; Ensuring the implementation of the risk assessment process and fulfillment of compliance obligations in the work unit in accordance with the policies, guidelines, and procedures applicable in the Corporation; 2 Mendampingi unit kerja (Risk Champion) dalam penyusunan asesmen risiko incidental; Assisting work units (Risk Champions) in the preparation of incidental risk assessments; 3 Menyusun laporan-laporan terkait pengelolaan risiko, pengelolaan kewajiban kepatuhan dan pengelolaan anti penyuapan Perseroan; Preparing reports related to risk management, compliance obligation management and anti-bribery management of the Corporation; 4 Melakukan pengukuran Risk Maturity dan/atau GRC Maturity Perseroan sesuai dengan tools yang berlaku di Perseroan; Measuring the Corporation's Risk Maturity and/or GRC Maturity in accordance with the applicable tools in the Corporation; 5 Memastikan terlaksananya program pengembangan budaya risiko, budaya kepatuhan dan budaya anti penyuapan serta pengembangan kompetensinya di seluruh insan Perseroan; Ensuring the implementation of risk culture, compliance culture and anti-bribery culture development programs as well as the development of competence in all employees of the Corporation; 6 Memastikan hasil temuan audit internal dan eksternal berdasarkan standar ISO (Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuapan dan Sistem Manajemen Kepatuhan) ditindaklanjuti oleh unit kerja terkait; Ensuring the findings of internal and external audits based on ISO standards (Anti-Bribery Management System and Compliance Management System) are followed up by the relevant work units; 7 Melakukan penyusunan atau pemutakhiran kebijakan, pedoman, dan prosedur manajemen risiko, manajemen kepatuhan, manajemen anti penyuapan termasuk teknologi pendukungnya (jika dibutuhkan); Preparing or updating policies, guidelines, and procedures for risk management, compliance management, anti-bribery management including supporting technology (if needed); 8 Mendampingi unit kerja (Risk Champion) dalam penyusunan dan pemantauan Top Risk Perseroan; Assisting the work unit (Risk Champion) in the preparation and monitoring of the Corporation's Top Risk; 9 Menyusun rancangan risk appetite dan risk tolerance untuk disampaikan kepada Direksi; Drafting risk appetite and risk tolerance to be submitted to the Board of Directors; 10 Memantau kemajuan realisasi atas rencana respons terhadap risiko di unit kerja; Monitoring the progress of realization of the risk response plan in the work unit; 11 Melakukan reviu untuk mengecek kesesuaian, keselarasan dan kepatuhan atas rancangan peraturan internal di unit kerja; dan Conducting reviews to check the suitability, alignment, and compliance of the draft internal regulations in the work unit; and 12 Melakukan reviu atas laporan pengelolaan risiko yang disampaikan oleh Anak Perusahaan/Perusahaan Patungan.
Reviewing the risk management reports submitted by Subsidiaries/Joint Ventures.
B. DEPARTEMEN QSSHE ASSURANCE QSSHE ASSURANCE DEPARTMENT Kegiatan Activities 1 Membuat, mengkaji dan mensosialisasikan kebijakan dan standar corporate (prosedur dan instruksi) terkait quality, safety, security, health dan environment; Creating, reviewing and disseminating corporate policies and standards (procedures and instructions) related to quality, safety, security, health and environment; 2 Melakukan proses perencanaan, pengendalian, dan pemantauan kegiatan QSSHE dari kegiatan operasional perusahaan yang berpotensi berisiko kepada perusahaan sesuai dengan standar yang ditetapkan; Planning, controlling, and monitoring QSSHE activities from the Corporation's operational activities that have the potential to pose a risk to the Corporation in accordance with established standards; 3 Melakukan dan memfasilitasi proses investigasi serta pelaporan terkait insiden QSSHE yang terjadi di area kerja; Conducting and facilitating the investigation and reporting process related to QSSHE incidents that occur in the work area; Duties and Responsibilities of Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Division Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Division has duties and responsibilities: 685 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Kegiatan Activities 4 Melakukan assurance terhadap kegiatan atau program korporat terkait quality, safety, security, health, dan environment, seperti melakukan monitoring terhadap leading dan lagging indicator yang telah ditetapkan; memastikan implementasi aspek QSSHE di lapangan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku; serta melakukan review, baik melalui inspeksi maupun audit, pada aspek QSSHE; Performing assurance on corporate activities or programs related to quality, safety, security, health, and environment, such as: monitoring the leading and lagging indicators that have been determined; ensuring the implementation of QSSHE aspects in the field in accordance with what is regulated; conducting reviews (inspections and audits) on QSSHE aspects; 5 Merencanakan dan memastikan terlaksananya program pengembangan sistem manajemen terkait QSSHE perusahaan; Planning and ensuring the implementation of the Corporation's QSSHE related management system development program; 6 Melakukan evaluasi dan melaporkan hasil kegiatan pada aspek QSSHE untuk kegiatan operasional; Evaluating and reporting the results of activities on QSSHE aspects for operational activities; 7 Menentukan sistem monitoring dan pelaporan serta mekanisme evaluasi & pengukuran efektivitas; Determining monitoring and reporting systems as well as evaluation & effectiveness measurement mechanisms; 8 Memfasilitasi konsultasi kepada unit kerja mengenai sistem menajemen dan implementasi terkait aspek QSSHE; Facilitating consultation to work units regarding management system and implementation related to QSSHE aspects; 9 Mengidentifikasi peraturan terkait dengan aspek QSSHE yang berkaitan dengan kegiatan operasional perusahaan dan mengevaluasi pemenuhannya; Identifying regulations related to QSSHE aspects related to the Corporation's operational activities and evaluating their fulfillment; 10 Menyusun laporan eksternal terkait aspek QSSHE yang ditetapkan berdasarkan izin ataupun peraturan yang berlaku untuk operasional Perseroan; Preparing external reports related to QSSHE aspects stipulated based on licenses or regulations applicable to the Corporation's operations; 11 Merencanakan dan menjalankan program pengembangan budaya terkait aspek QSSHE dan mengukur efektivitasnya; Planning and implementing cultural development programs related to QSSHE aspects and measuring their effectiveness; 12 Mengelola dan menganalisis data terkait aspek lingkungan dan leading & lagging indicator untuk memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar maupun peraturan; Managing and analyzing data related to environmental aspects and leading & lagging indicators to ensure compliance with standards and regulations; 13 Mendampingi kegiatan simulasi tanggap darurat yang dilakukan pada area konstruksi dan operasi & pemeliharaan; Assisting emergency response simulation activities carried out in the construction and operations & maintenance areas; 14 Memastikan hasil temuan audit internal dan eksternal, hasil patrol, hasil meeting bulanan P2K3 ditindaklanjuti oleh unit kerja terkait; dan Ensuring that the findings of internal and external audits, patrol results, results of P2K3 monthly meetings are followed up by the relevant work units; and 15 Melakukan asurans terhadap implementasi QSSHE di Anak Perusahaan/Perusahaan Patungan. Conducting assurance on QSSHE implementation in Subsidiaries/Joint Ventures C. DEPARTEMEN BUSINESS CONTINUITY MANAGEMENT BUSINESS CONTINUITY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT Kegiatan Activities 1 Melakukan pendampingan unit kerja dalam implementasi business continuity management; Assisting work units in implementing business continuity management; 2 Melakukan penyusunan business continuity management framework, pendampingan business impact analysis dan pengukuran risiko dan ancaman di Unit Kerja; Conducting the preparation of business continuity management framework, business impact analysis assistance and measurement of risks and threats in the Work Unit; 3 Melakukan program peningkatan awareness business continuity management Perseroan; Conducting a program to increase awareness of the Corporation's business continuity management; 4 Melakukan evaluasi implementasi dan peningkatan proses pengelolaan business continuity management Perseroan; Evaluating the implementation and improvement of the Corporation's business continuity management process; 5 Memastikan dan mendampingi proses simulasi/pengujian BCM Unit Kerja; dan Ensuring and assisting the BCM simulation/testing process of the Work Unit; and 6 Mendampingi proses pemulihan di Unit Kerja saat terjadinya kondisi krisis.
Assisting the recovery process in the Work Unit during crisis conditions.

Divisi Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance diangkat dan diberhentikan oleh Direktur Utama atas persetujuan Dewan Komisaris.
Pelaksanaan Tugas Divisi Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Sepanjang tahun 2024, Divisi Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance telah menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya antara lain: 1. Memimpin proses pengembangan GRC Terintegrasi, BCM, SMAP , SMK, dan sistem manajemen QSSHE di Perseroan; Appointment and Dismissal Mechanism of Head of Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Division The Head of Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Division is appointed and dismissed by the President Director with the approval of the Board of Commissioners.
Implementation of Duties of Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Division Throughout 2024, the Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Division carried out its duties and responsibilities, among others: 1. Leading the development process of Integrated GRC, BCM, SMAP , SMK, and QSSHE management systems in the Corporation; 690 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance 2. Memimpin proses perencanaan, pengendalian, dan pemantauan kegiatan GRC Terintegrasi, BCM, SMAP , SMK, dan sistem manajemen QSSHE dari kegiatan operasional Perseroan; 3. Menyusun strategi implementasi, kerangka manajemen, infrastruktur, sistem pemantauan dan pelaporan serta mekanisme evaluasi & pengukuran efektivitas dari GRC Terintegrasi, BCM, SMAP , SMK, dan sistem manajemen QSSHE; 4. Memberikan advis kepada Manajemen Puncak terkait penerapan, analisa, dan evaluasi terkait aspek GRC Terintegrasi, BCM, SMAP , SMK, dan sistem manajemen QSSHE; 5. Memimpin pengembangan budaya GRC Terintegrasi, BCM, SMAP , SMK, dan QSSHE di Perseroan; 6. Memastikan terlaksananya kewajiban pelaporan baik internal maupun eksternal perihal GRC Terintegrasi, BCM, SMAP , SMK, dan QSSHE yang ditetapkan berdasarkan izin ataupun peraturan yang berlaku untuk operasional Perseroan; 7. Memastikan terlaksananya proses investigasi serta pelaporan terkait insiden QSSHE yang terjadi di area kerja; dan 8. Memastikan terlaksananya pemantauan implementasi manajemen risiko, QSSHE, dan BCM di Anak Perusahaan/Perusahaan Patungan.
2. Leading the process of planning, controlling, and monitoring the Integrated GRC, BCM, SMAP , SMK, and QSSHE management systems of the Corporation’s operational activities; 3. Developing implementation strategy, management framework, infrastructure, monitoring and reporting system as well as evaluation & effectiveness measurement mechanism of Integrated GRC, BCM, SMAP , SMK, and QSSHE management system; 4. Advising Top Management on the implementation, analysis, and evaluation related to aspects of Integrated GRC, BCM, SMAP , SMK, and QSSHE management system; 5. Leading the development of Integrated GRC, BCM, SMAP , SMK, and QSSHE culture in the Corporation; 6. Ensuring the implementation of both internal and external reporting obligations regarding Integrated GRC, BCM, SMAP , SMK, and QSSHE stipulated under the licenses or regulations applicable to the Corporation’s operations; 7. Ensuring the implementation of the investigation process and reporting related to QSSHE incidents that occur in the work area; and 8. Ensuring the monitoring of risk management, QSSHE, and BCM implementation in Subsidiaries/ Joint Ventures.
691 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Fungsi pengawasan independen terhadap aspek keuangan Perseroan dilakukan dengan melaksanakan pemeriksaan Audit Eksternal yang dilakukan oleh Kantor Akuntan Publik (KAP). Auditor Eksternal yang memeriksa laporan keuangan ditetapkan melalui RUPS Tahunan berdasarkan rekomendasi dari Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Audit. Proses pemilihannya dilakukan sesuai dengan mekanisme pengadaan barang dan jasa yang berlaku. Dewan Komisaris menyampaikan alasan pencalonan tersebut kepada RUPS dan besarnya honorarium/imbalan jasa yang diusulkan untuk Auditor Eksternal tersebut. Untuk proses penunjukan calon Auditor Eksternal dan/atau penunjukan kembali Auditor Eksternal yang dilakukan oleh RUPS, Dewan Komisaris cukup memberikan kuasa kepada RUPS untuk menetapkan auditor tersebut. Untuk menjamin independensi dan kualitas hasil pemeriksaan, Auditor Eksternal yang ditunjuk tidak boleh memiliki benturan kepentingan dengan Perseroan.
Audit Eksternal External Audit The function of independent supervision of the Corporation's financial aspects is carried out by carrying out an External Audit examination conducted by the Public Accounting Firm (KAP). The External Auditor who examines the financial statements is determined through the Annual GMS based on recommendations from the Board of Commissioners and the Audit Committee. The selection process is carried out in accordance with the applicable goods and services procurement mechanism. The Board of Commissioners submits the reasons for the nomination to the GMS and the amount of honorarium/ service fee proposed for the External Auditor. For the process of appointing the External Auditor candidate and/or reappointing the External Auditor conducted by the GMS, the Board of Commissioners is sufficient to authorize the GMS to determine the auditor. To ensure the independence and quality of the audit results, the appointed External Auditor must not have a conflict of interest with the Corporation.

Wajar Tanpa Pengecualian Unqualified Rp670.000.000,-695 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Sistem Pengendalian Internal Internal Control System The internal control system in the Corporation aims to support the achievement of the Corporation's performance objectives, increase value for stakeholders and ensure operational effectiveness and efficiency, reliability of financial reporting, feasibility of operational and financial controls, and compliance with laws and other regulations.
Internal Control System Guidelines The Corporation has SPI Guidelines established through Board of Directors Regulation No. PER/023-1/BOD-MRT/ IX/2021 on Internal Control System Guidelines within PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) which are prepared with reference to: 1. Law No. 40 of 2007 on Limited Liability Companies; 2. Law No. 23 of 2014 on Regional Government; and 3. Decree of the Governor of the Provincial Government of DKI Jakarta No. 96 of 2004 on the Implementation of Good Corporate Governance Practices in Regional-Owned Enterprises (BUMD) within the Government of the Special Capital Region of Jakarta.
The purpose of making and implementing the Guidelines: • Demonstrate the Corporation's commitment in realizing Good Corporate Governance to all stakeholders; and • Understanding for the Corporation's internal regarding the framework and management of the Corporation's Internal Control System.
Financial and Operational Control In carrying out daily business operations, the Corporation always implements strict financial control mechanisms starting from the implementation of the separation of functions, duties, and responsibilities related to financial transactions, the Corporation's bookkeeping, or asset documentation.
Then from the operational side, the Corporation always conducts periodic updates on all policies, procedures, operational systems and accounting standards to describe actual operational activities. This is in line with the Corporation's internal control system which continues to build an organizational control system by involving all available resources.
Sistem pengendalian internal di Perseroan bertujuan untuk mendukung pencapaian tujuan kinerja Perseroan, meningkatkan nilai bagi pemangku kepentingan dan menjamin efektivitas dan efisiensi operasional, keandalan pelaporan keuangan, kelayakan pengendalian operasional maupun finansial, serta kepatuhan terhadap hukum dan peraturan perundang-undangan lainnya.
Pedoman Sistem Pengendalian Internal Perseroan memiliki Pedoman SPI yang ditetapkan melalui Peraturan Direksi No. PER/023-1/BOD-MRT/ IX/2021 tentang Pedoman Sistem Pengendalian Internal di Lingkungan PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) disusun dengan mengacu pada: 1. Undang-Undang No. 40 Tahun 2007 tentang Perseroan Terbatas; 2. Undang-Undang No. 23 Tahun 2014 tentang Pemerintahan Daerah; dan 3. Surat Keputusan Gubernur Pemerintah Provinsi DKI Jakarta No. 96 Tahun 2004 tentang Penerapan Praktik Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik pada Badan Usaha Milik Daerah (BUMD) di Lingkungan Pemerintah Daerah Khusus Ibu Kota Jakarta. Tujuan pembuatan dan penerapan Pedoman: • Menunjukkan komitmen Perseroan dalam mewujudkan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang baik kepada seluruh pemangku kepentingan; dan • Pemahaman bagi internal Perseroan tentang kerangka dan manajemen Sistem Pengendalian Internal Perseroan.
Pengendalian Keuangan dan Operasional Dalam menjalankan aktivitas operasional bisnis sehari-hari, Perseroan senantiasa menerapkan mekanisme pengendalian keuangan secara ketat, dimulai dari diberlakukannya pemisahan fungsi, tugas, dan tanggung jawab terkait transaksi keuangan, pembukuan Perseroan, ataupun dokumentasi aset.
Kemudian dari sisi operasional, Perseroan senantiasa melakukan update berkala atas seluruh kebijakan, prosedur, sistem operasional dan standar akuntansi guna menggambarkan kegiatan operasional yang aktual. Hal ini sejalan dengan sistem pengendalian internal yang berlaku di Perseroan yang terus membangun sistem kontrol organisasi dengan melibatkan seluruh sumber daya yang ada.
696 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Perseroan juga telah melakukan audit kepatuhan atas pengendalian internal dan perundang-undangan yang dilakukan oleh Kantor Akuntan Publik Amir Abadi Jusuf, Aryanto, Mawar & Rekan. Penerapan Sistem Pengendalian Internal di Lingkup Perseroan. Pengendalian intern atas operasional dan Pelaporan Keuangan Perseroan dijalankan dengan mengacu pada acuan internasional COSO (Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of The Treadway Commissions) yang meliputi 5 komponen pengendalian yaitu: 1. Lingkungan pengendalian; 2. Penilaian risiko; 3. Aktivitas pengendalian; 4. Informasi dan komunikasi; dan 5. Monitoring. SISTEM PENGENDALIAN INTERNAL MRT JAKARTA SESUAI KERANGKA COSO MRT JAKARTA’S INTERNAL CONTROL SYSTEM IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE COSO FRAMEWORK Komponen Component Prinsip Principle Penerapan di Lingkup Perseroan Implementation within the Corporation Lingkungan Pengendalian Control Environment • Organisasi menunjukkan komitmen terhadap integritas dan nilai-nilai etika; • Dewan pengawas menunjukkan independensinya dari manajemen dan melaksanakan pengawasan atas pengembangan dan kinerja pengendalian intern; • Manajemen dengan pengawasan dari dewan pengawas menetapkan struktur organisasi, garis pelaporan, serta wewenang dan tanggung jawab yang tepat dalam rangka pencapaian tujuan; • Organisasi menunjukkan komitmen dalam merekrut, mengembangkan, dan mempertahankan individu-individu yang kompeten sesuai dengan tujuan yang ditetapkan; dan • Organisasi memegang akuntabilitas individu-individu atas pelaksanaan pengendalian intern dalam rangka pencapaian tujuan.
• The organization demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values; • The supervisory board demonstrates its independence from management and exercises oversight over the development and performance of internal controls; • Management with oversight from the supervisory board establishes an appropriate organizational structure, reporting lines, and authority and responsibility in order to achieve objectives; • The organization demonstrates a commitment to recruiting, developing, and retaining competent individuals in accordance with its objectives; and • The organization holds individuals accountable for the implementation of internal control in order to achieve objectives.
Perseroan telah mengembangkan dan menciptakan lingkungan pengendalian yang baik melalui pembangunan budaya Perseroan, seperti adanya kesepakatan seluruh karyawan Perseroan akan nilai-nilai Perseroan dan aturan perilaku, serta adanya penyusunan struktur organisasi yang mencerminkan pendelegasian kewenangan dan pembagian tugas yang jelas sesuai dengan strategi Perseroan, kebijakan SDM yang berbasis kepada kompetensi, dan pengembangan tata kelola Perseroan yang baik secara terus menerus.
The Corporation has developed and created a good control environment through the development of the Corporation's culture, such as the agreement of all employees of the Corporation on the Corporation's values and rules of conduct, as well as the preparation of an organizational structure that reflects the delegation of authority and clear division of tasks in accordance with the Corporation's strategy, competency-based HR policies, and the continuous development of good corporate governance.
Penilaian Risiko Risk Assessment • Organisasi menetapkan tujuan-tujuan yang jelas agar dapat dilakukan identifikasi dan penilaian risiko terkait tujuan tersebut; • Organisasi mengidentifikasi risiko atas pencapaian tujuan secara menyeluruh dan menganalisis risiko sebagai landasan pengelolaan risiko; • Organisasi mempertimbangkan potensi kecurangan (fraud) dalam melakukan penilaian risiko atas pencapaian tujuan; dan • Organisasi mengidentifikasi dan menilai perubahan-perubahan yang dapat berdampak signifikan terhadap sistem pengendalian intern.
Guna menjamin adanya sadar risiko pada setiap karyawan, Perseroan telah membangun budaya risiko di setiap unsur dan proses utama. Perseroan telah menetapkan Divisi Risk Management & QSSHE Assurance sebagai leader dalam pengembangan manajemen risiko, baik itu pada risiko level korporasi maupun unit kerja sehingga tersedia Risk Register di masing-masing unit kerja. Risk Register selalu dievaluasi setiap 3 bulan.
The Corporation has also conducted a compliance audit on internal control and legislation conducted by Amir Abadi Jusuf, Aryanto, Mawar & Rekan Public Accounting Firm.
Implementation of Internal Control System within the Corporation Internal control over the Corporation's operations and financial reporting is carried out with reference to the international reference of COSO (Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commissions) which includes 5 control components, as follows: 1. Control environment; 2. Risk assessment; 3. Control activities; 4. Information and communication; and 5. Monitoring.
697 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Komponen Component Prinsip Principle Penerapan di Lingkup Perseroan Implementation within the Corporation • The organization sets clear objectives to enable the identification and assessment of risks associated with those objectives; • The organization identifies risks to achieving objectives thoroughly and analyzes risks as a basis for risk management; • The organization considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to achieving objectives; and • The organization identifies and assesses changes that could have a significant impact on the internal control system.
To ensure risk awareness in every employee, the Corporation has built a risk culture in every element and main process. The Corporation has established the Risk Management & QSSHE Assurance Division as the leader in the development of risk management, both at the corporate and work unit level risks so that there is a Risk Register in each work unit. The Risk Register is always evaluated every 3 months.
Aktivitas Pengendalian Control Activities • Organisasi memilih dan mengembangkan kegiatan pengendalian, yang berkontribusi meminimalkan risiko atas pencapaian tujuan sampai pada level yang dapat diterima; • Organisasi memilih dan mengembangkan kegiatan pengendalian umum atas teknologi untuk mendukung pencapaian tujuan; dan • Organisasi memberlakukan kegiatan pengendalian, melalui kebijakan yang menetapkan apa yang diharapkan dan melalui prosedur yang menjabarkan kebijakan menjadi tindakan.
• The organization selects and develops control activities that contribute to minimizing risks to the achievement of objectives to an acceptable level; • The organization selects and develops general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives; and • The organization enforces control activities through policies that define what is expected and through procedures that translate policies into actions.
Untuk menjamin bahwa seluruh proses utama Perseroan telah dilakukan secara baik, memenuhi unsur efektivitas, efisiensi, dan dilengkapi dengan akuntabilitas serta pertanggungjawaban yang baik. Perseroan telah melakukan identifikasi proses-proses yang diperlukan dalam pengelolaan, baik itu pada divisi yang bersifat teknis maupun pada divisi pendukung. Hal ini dilakukan untuk memastikan bahwa setiap proses pengelolaan telah dilengkapi standar operasi dan prosedur yang ditetapkan oleh Direksi. Hal ini merupakan bagian dari mitigasi risiko dari masing-masing Risk Register unit kerja yang bersangkutan. Dalam penyusunan SOP untuk operasi, pemeliharaan dan perawatan MRT Jakarta, Perseroan dibantu oleh Konsultan Internasional.
To ensure that all of the Corporation's main processes have been carried out properly, fulfill the elements of effectiveness, efficiency, and are equipped with good accountability and responsibility. The Corporation has identified the processes required in management, both in the technical division and in the supporting division. This is done to ensure that each management process is equipped with standard operations and procedures set by the Board of Directors. This is part of the risk mitigation of each Risk Register of the work unit concerned. In the preparation of SOPs for the operation, maintenance, and maintenance of MRT Jakarta, the Corporation was assisted by an International Consultant.
Informasi dan Komunikasi Information and Communication • Organisasi memperoleh, menghasilkan dan menggunakan informasi yang relevan dan berkualitas untuk mendukung berfungsinya komponen pengendalian intern lainnya; • Organisasi melakukan komunikasi informasi secara intern, termasuk tujuan dan tanggung jawab pengendalian intern, yang diperlukan untuk mendukung berfungsinya pengendalian intern; dan • Organisasi menjalin komunikasi dengan pihak-pihak eksternal terkait hal-hal yang memengaruhi berfungsinya komponen pengendalian intern lainnya.
• The organization obtains, generates and uses relevant and quality information to support the proper functioning of other internal control components; • The organization communicates internally information, including internal control objectives and responsibilities, necessary to support the proper functioning of internal control; and • The organization communicates with external parties regarding matters that affect the functioning of other internal control components.
Sebagai Perseroan yang sedang mengerjakan proyek untuk kepentingan publik, manajemen sangat menyadari pentingnya komunikasi dan informasi, khususnya komunikasi dan informasi tentang jalannya pekerjaan proyek, progres proyek dan dampaknya terhadap pelayanan publik lainnya. Fungsi komunikasi dan informasi dikoordinasikan oleh Divisi Corporate Secretary. Hal-hal yang telah dilakukan, di antaranya membangun, memantau, dan mengevaluasi situs web. Di samping itu, kegiatan lain dilakukan melalui sosialisasi kegiatan proyek, baik dengan cara tinjauan langsung kepada masyarakat sekitar jalur proyek maupun melakukan seminar dan konferensi pers.
As a Corporation that is working on projects for the public interest, management is very aware of the importance of communication and information, especially communication and information about the course of project work, project progress and its impact on other public services. The communication and information function is coordinated by the Corporate Secretary Division. Things that have been done include building, monitoring and evaluating the website. In addition, other activities are carried out through the socialization of project activities, both by way of direct reviews to the community around the project line as well as conducting seminars and press conferences.
698 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Komponen Component Prinsip Principle Penerapan di Lingkup Perseroan Implementation within the Corporation Monitoring • Organisasi memilih, mengembangkan, dan melaksanakan evaluasi secara terus-menerus (berkelanjutan) dan/atau secara terpisah, untuk memastikan bahwa komponen-komponen pengendalian intern benar-benar ada dan berfungsi; dan • Organisasi mengevaluasi dan mengkomunikasikan kelemahan pengendalian intern secara tepat waktu kepada pihak- pihak yang bertanggung jawab untuk mengambil tindakan korektif, termasuk manajemen puncak dan Dewan Pengawas, sebagaimana mestinya.
• The organization selects, develops, and conducts ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ensure that internal control components are in place and functioning; and • The organization evaluates and communicates internal control weaknesses in a timely manner to those responsible for taking corrective action, including top management and the Board of Trustees, as appropriate.
Untuk memastikan bahwa Sistem Pengendalian Internal Perseroan telah berjalan dengan baik, manajemen dan unit-unit kerja terkait diwajibkan melakukan pemantauan dan perbaikan secara terus menerus atas penerapan Sistem Pengendalian Internal. Selain itu, Internal Audit secara terpisah juga melakukan pemantauan terhadap implementasi Sistem Pengendalian Internal. Fungsi pemantauan juga dilakukan Komite Audit dan Auditor Publik.
To ensure that the Corporation's Internal Control System is running well, management and related work units are required to continuously monitor and improve the implementation of the Internal Control System. In addition, Internal Audit separately also monitors the implementation of the Internal Control System. The monitoring function is also carried out by the Audit Committee and Public Auditor.
Tinjauan atas Efektivitas Sistem Pengendalian Internal Direksi bertanggungjawab memastikan penerapan Sistem Pengendalian Intern (SPI) yang andal dan efektif serta berkewajiban meningkatkan dan memastikan budaya sadar risiko melekat di setiap jenjang organisasi. Divisi Internal Audit bertanggung jawab melaksanakan evaluasi kecukupan, efektivitas dan efisiensi SPI serta berperan aktif dalam meningkatkan efektivitas SPI secara berkesinambungan untuk mencapai tujuan yang telah ditetapkan MRT Jakarta. Divisi Internal Audit melakukan penilaian terhadap 2 tingkatan pengendalian. • Penilaian atas Pengendalian Tingkat Perseroan (Entity Level) Proses Pengendalian Internal tidak terpisahkan dalam setiap proses bisnis dan pengelolaan risikonya. Proses tersebut wajib dilaksanakan setiap karyawan pada seluruh unit kerja di Perseroan (entity level). Pelaksanaan proses pengendalian internal pada unit kerja akan dievaluasi dan dinilai melalui penilaian mandiri setiap tahun. • Penilaian atas Pengendalian tingkat Aktivitas Risiko operasional adalah risiko yang disebabkan adanya ketidakcukupan dan/atau tidak berfungsinya proses internal, kesalahan manusia, kegagalan sistem, atau adanya permasalahan eksternal yang memengaruhi operasional Perseroan. Risiko operasional bersifat tanpa batas dan melekat pada semua aktivitas bisnis dan operasional Perseroan. Perseroan bergerak dalam bidang transportasi umum, maka risiko operasional merupakan prioritas utama untuk pengendalian internal. Oleh sebab itu, perlu dilakukan penilaian atas kecukupan efektivitas pengendalian (“Control”) pengendalian internal yang sudah ditetapkan Perseroan berdasarkan Pedoman dan Prosedur (“Compliance”). Review of the Effectiveness of Internal Control System The Board of Directors is responsible for ensuring the implementation of a reliable and effective Internal Control System (SPI) and is obliged to improve and ensure a risk-aware culture is embedded at every level of the organization. The Internal Audit Division is responsible for evaluating the adequacy, effectiveness and efficiency of SPI and plays an active role in continuously improving the effectiveness of SPI to achieve the objectives set by MRT Jakarta. The Internal Audit Division conducts an assessment of 2 levels of control.
• Assessment of Corporation Level Control (Entity Level) The Internal Control process is inseparable in every business process and risk management. The process must be implemented by every employee in all work units in the Corporation (entity level). The implementation of the internal control process in the work unit will be evaluated and assessed through a self-assessment every year.
• Assessment of Activity-level Controls Operational risk is the risk caused by the inadequacy and/or malfunction of internal processes, human error, system failure, or external problems that affect the Corporation’s operations. Operational risk is limitless and inherent in all business activities and operations of the Corporation. As the Corporation is engaged in public transportation, operational risk is a top priority for internal control. Therefore, it is necessary to assess the adequacy of the effectiveness of internal control (“Control”) that has been established by the Corporation based on the Guidelines and Procedures (“Compliance”) 699 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Pada tahun 2024, evaluasi penerapan SPI Perseroan dilakukan oleh Perwakilan BPKP Provinsi DKI Jakarta, dengan Surat Tugas Kepala Perwakilan BPKP DKI Jakarta No. PE.12.02/ST-719/PW09/4.2/2024 perihal Evaluasi Penerapan Sistem Pengendalian Intern pada PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) Tahun 2024. Hasil evaluasi SPI Perseroan menunjukkan nilai capaian 88,804% atau dalam kategori ”Sangat Efektif”. Penilaian efektivitas pengendalian internal ini merupakan kombinasi dari hasil pencapaian 5 elemen yang membentuk dan menjadi bagian dari pengendalian internal. Hal ini sesuai dengan kerangka pengendalian internal sebagaimana dirumuskan oleh COSO serta sesuai dengan Kebijakan Perseroan. Hasil pencapaian kelima elemen yang mendukung simpulan pengendalian internal berikut ini.

MRT Jakarta berkomitmen dalam menjalankan manajemen risiko yang baik dengan memiliki kebijakan, proses, kompetensi, akuntabilitas, pelaporan dan teknologi pendukung yang bertujuan agar pengelolaan risiko Perseroan senantiasa berjalan efektif dan efisien. Pihak yang mengelola manajemen risiko adalah Divisi Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance.
MRT Jakarta conducts proactive and prudent risk management in every business and operational process to achieve optimal profitability in accordance with the predetermined risk appetite. MRT Jakarta is committed to carrying out good risk management by having policies, processes, competencies, accountability, reporting, and supporting technology that aim to keep the Corporation’s risk management running effectively and efficiently. The party that manages risk management is the Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Division.

Kebijakan Manajemen Risiko yang berlaku di Perseroan, tujuan pengelolaan risiko adalah sebagai berikut: • Melindungi dari risiko signifikan yang dapat menghambat pencapaian tujuan perusahaan serta mendorong manajemen untuk bertindak proaktif, terhadap pengelolaan risiko dan menjadikannya sebagai sumber keunggulan bersaing dan kinerja Perseroan; • Membangun kesadaran bertindak hati-hati dan kemampuan dalam pengelolaan risiko, sesuai dengan kedudukan dan tanggung jawabnya masing-masing sebagai bagian dari pengelolaan risiko yang terintegrasi; dan • Meningkatkan kinerja Perseroan melalui penyediaan informasi tingkat risiko yang dituangkan dalam peta risiko (risk map) yang berguna bagi manajemen dalam pengembangan strategi dan perbaikan proses manajemen risiko termasuk Key Risk Indicator (KRI) secara terus menerus dan berkesinambungan.
Risk Appetite Perseroan selalu melakukan pengembangan risk appetite yang akan menjadi pertimbangan dalam pengambilan Keputusan Perseroan. Terdapat 4 tingkat Risk Appetite yang telah disetujui oleh Direksi, diantaranya adalah: Tingkat Risk Appetite Risk Appetite Index Definisi Tingkat Risk Appetite Definition of Risk Appetite Index Very Low Appetite • Pendekatan sangat hati-hati dan konservatif; dan • Tidak memiliki toleransi atas ketidakpastian dalam pencapaian sasaran strategis Perseroan (zero tolerance).
• Very cautious and conservative approach; and • Zero tolerance for uncertainty in achieving the Corporation’s strategic objectives.
Low Appetite • Pendekatan hati-hati dan konservatif; • Cenderung memilih opsi teraman untuk menghindari dampak katastropik; dan • Memiliki toleransi yang sangat terbatas atas ketidakpastian dalam pencapaian sasaran strategis Perseroan.
• Cautious and conservative approach; • Tend to choose the safest option to avoid catastrophic impacts; and • Have very limited tolerance for uncertainty in achieving the Corporation’s strategic goals.
Medium Appetite • Pendekatan terukur dan dimusyawarahkan; • Mitigasi risiko dilakukan dengan mempertimbangkan cost & benefit; dan • Tingkat toleransi bersifat relative terhadap pencapaian misi dan sasaran Perseroan.
• Measured and deliberated approach; • Risk mitigation is done by considering cost & benefit; and • The tolerance index is relative in achieving the Corporation’s mission and objectives High Appetite • Pendekatan yang fleksibel atas ketidakpastian yang tinggi dalam mengejar peluang; dan • Bersedia menoleransi ketidakpastian dalam pencapaian sasaran strategis Perseroan.
• Flexible approach to high uncertainty in pursuit of opportunities; and • Willing to tolerate uncertainty in achieving the Corporation’s strategic goals.
Objectives of Risk Management Implementation In accordance with the Risk Management Policy of the Corporation, the risk management are as follows: • Protect from significant risks that can hinder the achievement of the Corporation’s objectives and encourage the management to act proactively towards risk management and make it as a source of competitive advantages and the Corporation performance; • Build awareness of mindful actions and risk management competency according to the positions and responsibilities of each employee as a part of integrated risk management; and • Improve the Corporation performance by providing risk level information as outlined in the risk map, which is useful for management in developing strategies and improving the risk management process, including the Key Risk Indicator (KRI), continuously and sustainably.
Risk Appetite The Corporation always develops the risk appetite which will be taken into consideration in the Corporation’s decision making. Tinjauan atas Efektivitas Sistem Manajemen Risiko Salah satu cara untuk mengetahui pengelolaan risiko MRT Jakarta telah dilakukan dengan baik sesuai dengan standarnya adalah dengan mengevaluasi implementasi manajemen risiko tersebut melalui penilaian maturitas risiko Perseroan. Penilaian maturitas ini ditetapkan melalui Peraturan Direktur Utama No. 002 Tahun 2023 tentang Pedoman Manajemen Risiko di Lingkungan PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) dan diturunkan dalam SOP-Below is the Risk Appetite for MRT Jakarta in 2024: Review of the Effectiveness of Risk Management System One way to know that MRT Jakarta’s risk management has been carried out properly in accordance with its standards is to evaluate the implementation of risk management through the Corporation’s risk maturity assessment. This maturity assessment is stipulated through President Director Regulation No. 002 of 2023 on Risk Management Guidelines within PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) and derived in SOP-RMQA/ 706 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance ERMC016 Revision 02 on Procedures for Evaluating Risk Management Implementation. The evaluation is carried out in the form of measuring the Corporation’s Risk Culture, Risk Conformity, and Risk Maturity which is carried out annually. In general, the evaluation objectives of the Corporation’s Risk Management System are as follows: 1. Assessing the adequacy of the design and effectiveness of risk management implementation within PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) through Risk Conformity measurement; 2. Understanding the index and perception of risk culture across all levels within PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) through Risk Culture measurement; 3. Understanding the index of risk management maturity within PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) for the purpose of continuous improvement through Risk Maturity measurement; and 4. Identifying components of Risk Management implementation that approach or have achieved best practices, and those requiring improvement (areas of improvement).
In 2024, the Corporation did not conduct Risk Conformity measurements based on ISO 31000:2018 because there were no changes to ISO 31000 standard. However, the Corporation conducted GRC Culture measurements, with one of the measurement components being Risk Culture, resulting in a Risk Culture value of 4.17. Lastly, the Corporation also developed a unified integrated instrument with OCEG v 3.5 measurement criteria to measure GRC Maturity value. Thus, there is an additional assessment criterion that causes a decrease in Risk Maturity from 4.15 (2023) to 4.11 (2024). The following are the Risk Maturity measurement results: RMQA/ERMC-016 Revisi 02 mengenai Prosedur Evaluasi Implementasi Manajemen Risiko. Evaluasi tersebut dilakukan dalam bentuk pengukuran Risk Culture, Risk Conformity, dan Risk Maturity Perseroan yang dilakukan setiap tahun. Secara umum, tujuan dari evaluasi Sistem Manajemen Risiko Perseroan adalah sebagai berikut: 1. Menilai kecukupan rancangan dan efektivitas implementasi manajemen risiko di lingkungan PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) melalui pengukuran Risk Conformity; 2. Mengetahui tingkat dan persepsi budaya risiko (risk culture) di seluruh tingkatan di PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) melalui pengukuran Risk Culture; 3. Mengetahui tingkat kematangan manajemen risiko di PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) untuk tujuan perbaikan berkelanjutan melalui pengukuran Risk Maturity; dan 4. Mengidentifikasi komponen-komponen implementasi Manajemen Risiko yang mendekati atau telah mencapai praktik terbaik, dan hal-hal yang memerlukan perbaikan (areas of improvement). Pada tahun 2024, Perseroan tidak melakukan pengukuran Risk Conformity berbasis ISO 31000:2018 karena tidak terdapat perubahan standar ISO 31000. Namun, Perseroan telah melakukan pengukuran Budaya GRC, dengan salah satu komponen pengukuran adalah Risk Culture, sehingga diperoleh nilai Risk Culture sebesar 4,17. Terakhir, Perseroan juga telah mengembangkan unified integrated instrument dengan kriteria pengukuran OCEG v 3.5 untuk mengukur nilai Maturitas GRC. Sehingga, terdapat penambahan kriteria penilaian, yang menyebabkan penurunan nilai kematangan manajemen risiko (Risk Maturity) dari 4,15 (2023) menjadi 4,11 (2024). Implementing real-time risk monitoring technology with visual dashboards and connecting the risk management system with the organization's operational data.
Untuk menghubungkan sistem manajemen risiko dengan data operasional Perseroan perlu ada pengembangan aplikasi sistem, baik itu menggantikan sistem yang ada atau mengembangkan sistem yang telah ada & melengkapinya dengan custom built. Oleh karena itu, perlu ada pemilihan opsi tersebut terlebih dahulu, yang kemudian dibuat kajian dan blueprintnya.
Connecting the risk management system with the Corporation's operational data requires developing a system application, either replacing the existing system or developing the existing system & equipping it with a custom built. Therefore, it is necessary to select the option first, study about it, and blueprint it.
2 Evaluasi risiko di semua lini proses kerja dan pengambilan keputusan dan mengoptimalkan penggunaan data analytics untuk prediksi risiko.
Evaluating risks in all lines of work processes and decision-making and optimizing the use of data analytics for risk prediction.
Prosedur risk analytics akan disahkan pada tahun 2025 dan implementasi risk analytic akan digunakan pada beberapa kajian risiko diunit kerja dengan menggunakan kertas kerja yang ada.
The risk analytics procedure will be ratified in 2025 and the implementation of risk analytics will be used in several risk studies in work units by using existing working papers.
3 Jadikan manajemen risiko sebagai bagian dari budaya kepemimpinan, dan nilai organisasi dengan pemimpin harus memberi contoh nyata dalam penerapan manajemen risiko.
Making risk management part of the leadership culture and organizational values ​ with leaders, who must provide real examples in implementing risk management.
Saat ini, setiap pengambilan keputusan mempertimbangkan kajian risiko, dan dalam hal monitoring pencapaian kinerja Perseroan telah mempertimbangkan Top Risk. Implementasi ini akan selalu ditingkatkan sesuai dengan kondisi terkini.
Currently, every decision-making considers risk studies and in terms of monitoring the Corporation's performance achievements, Top Risk has been considered. This implementation will always be improved according to current conditions.
4 Berikan apresiasi kepada unit atau individu yang berhasil mengelola risiko dengan baik.
Giving appreciation to units or individuals who have succeeded in managing risk properly.
Apresiasi untuk GRC Officer akan diberikan dalam bentuk kegiatan GRC Officer Awards dan diberikan apresiasi untuk mengembangkan technical kompetensinya dalam keikutsertaan pada Konferensi manajemen risiko atau pelatihan dan sertifikasi manajemen risiko. Namun, untuk implementasi ini, tetap mempertimbangkan ketersediaan anggaran Perseroan.
Appreciation for GRC Officers will be given in the form of GRC Officer Awards and appreciation to develop their technical competencies in participating in Risk Management Conference or risk management training and certification. However, to apply this, the Corporation's budget will still be considered.
5 Rutin lakukan evaluasi budaya risiko melalui survei atau asesmen dan melakukan benchmark praktik manajemen risiko terhadap standar global.
Routinely evaluating risk culture through surveys or assessments and benchmarking risk management practices against global standards.
Pengukuran risk culture sudah dilakukan secara rutin setiap tahun. Pada tahun 2025, Perseroan sudah mengembangkan Risk Culture menjadi GRC culture (mencakup aspek budaya risiko). Untuk pengukuran GRC culture akan dilakukan setiap tahun.
Risk culture measurements have been carried out routinely every year. In 2025, the Corporation has developed Risk Culture into a GRC culture (covering aspects of risk culture). GRC culture measurements will be carried out every year.

Pengesahan prosedur manajemen risiko akan disahkan pada tahun 2025 bersamaan dengan pengembangan sistem aplikasi manajemen risiko.
The risk management procedures will be ratified in 2025 along with the development of risk management implementation system.
4 Pembuatan panduan mencakup tata cara evaluasi dan analisis untuk implementasi (maturitas) GRC Terintegrasi dan budaya GRC Terintegrasi.
Creating guidelines that include evaluation and analysis procedures for the implementation (maturity) of Integrated GRC and Integrated GRC culture.
Kertas kerja evaluasi maturitas dan budaya telah disesuaikan dalam bentuk unified integrated instrument berdasarkan standar kriteria OCEG version 3.5. Untuk menyesuaikan kertas kerja tersebut, perlu dilakukan perubahan Pedoman evaluasi implementasi manajemen risiko yang telah ada.
The maturity and culture evaluation working papers have been adjusted in the form of a unified integrated instrument based on OCEG version 3.5 criteria standards. To adjust the working papers, changes need to be made to the existing Risk Management Implementation Evaluation Guidelines.
Sistem Manajemen Kelangsungan Usaha Potensi gangguan/bencana baik disebabkan oleh alam, manusia, teknologi, ataupun krisis lainnya yang merupakan ancaman bagi kelangsungan usaha. Oleh karena itu, Direksi MRT Jakarta melihat perlu dilakukan pengembangan dan penerapan Kebijakan Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) guna melindungi keamanan dan keselamatan jiwa pekerja, melindungi keselamatan jiwa penumpang dan stakeholders lainnya yang berada di lingkungan operasional Perseroan. Perseroan telah melakukan pemutakhiran Kebijakan dan Pedoman BCMS yang diatur melalui Peraturan Direksi No. 001 Tahun 2024 berbasis ISO 22301:2019. Sebagai turunan dari Kebijakan dan Pedoman BCMS, Perseroan juga telah melakukan pemutakhiran Business Continuity Plan, Crisis Management Plan, dan Disaster Recovery Plan. Perseroan telah melakukan peninjauan dan melengkapi analisis dampak bisnis sesuai dengan perkembangan organisasi di tahun 2024 untuk mendapatkan data fungsi bisnis kritis yang harus segera dipulihkan saat terjadi kondisi krisis.
Business Continuity Management System Potential disruptions/disasters both caused by nature, humans, technology, or other crises that pose a threat to MRT Jakarta’s business continuity. Therefore, MRT Jakarta’s Board of Directors considers it necessary to develop and implement a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) Policy to protect the security and safety of workers’ lives, protect the safety of passengers’ lives and other stakeholders in the Corporation’s operational environment. The Corporation has updated the BCMS Policy and Guidelines which are regulated through Board of Directors Regulation No. 001 Year 2024 based on ISO 22301:2019. As a derivative of the BCMS Policy and Guidelines, the Corporation has also updated the Business Continuity Plan, Crisis Management Plan, and Disaster Recovery Plan. The Corporation has reviewed and completed the business impact analysis in accordance with the development of the organization in 2024 to obtain data on critical business functions that must be restored immediately during a crisis condition.

Perseroan telah melakukan pengukuran tingkat kematangan BCM sebagai perwujudan evaluasi dan perbaikan berkelanjutan implementasi Sistem Manajemen Kelangsungan Usaha (BCMS). Pengukuran ini telah dilakukan sejak tahun 2021. Pada tahun 2024 Perseroan mengembangkan unified integrated tools BCM Maturity yang terintegrasi dengan tools GRC, Risk Management dan Compliance Maturity untuk mengurangi fatigue pengukuran di setiap tahunnya. Dalam tools baru yang dikembangkan komponen pengukuran terdiri dari 4 komponen, yaitu learn, align, perform, dan review di mana pada tools sebelumnya 7 komponen untuk aspek corporate competence dan 4 komponen untuk aspek BCM program. Perseroan akan menggunakan unified integrated instrument BCM ini untuk mengevaluasi tingkat kematangan implementasi BCM kedepannya.

The Corporation has measured the maturity level of BCM as a manifestation of evaluation and continuous improvement of the implementation of Business Continuity Management System (BCMS). This measurement has been carried out since 2021. In 2024, the Corporation developed a unified integrated BCM Maturity tool that is integrated with GRC, Risk Management and Compliance Maturity tools to reduce measurement fatigue every year. In the new tools developed, the measurement components consist of 4 components, namely learn, align, perform, and review where in the previous tools 7 components for the corporate competence aspect and 4 components for the BCM program aspect. The Corporation will use this unified integrated BCM instrument to evaluate the maturity level of BCM implementation in the future.
