Berdasarkan hasil penilaian atas implementasi praktik manajemen risiko pada tahun 2024, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi menyatakan bahwa: 1. Direksi senantiasa melakukan review terhadap efektivitas penerapan Manajemen Risiko di lingkungan Perseroan, termasuk juga menilai kecukupan prosedur, mekanisme dan infrastruktur Manajemen Risiko yang dimiliki Perseroan; 2. Direksi memahami bahwa Manajemen Risiko merupakan bagian yang tak terpisahkan dari praktik GRC (Governance, Risk, dan Compliance). Sehingga, seluruh inisiatif pengembangan maupun pelaksanaannya harus ditempatkan dalam konteks GRC Terintegrasi; 3. Manajemen Risiko dilakukan dengan landasan berpikir yang termaktub dalam Rencana Jangka Panjang Perusahaan (RJPP) berdasarkan pada tata nilai, sasaran dan strategi dengan prinsip Manajemen Risiko korporat yang bersifat melindungi, menciptakan nilai (value), transparan dan inklusif; The Board of Directors and/or Board of Commissioners’ Statement on the Adequacy of Risk Management System In managing the risk management system, the Corporation has references related to basic principles to support the implementation of good and sustainable risk management practices. Based on the assessment of the implementation of risk management practices in 2024, the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors stated that: 1. The Board of Directors continuously reviews the effectiveness of risk management implementation within the Corporation, including assessing the adequacy of procedures, mechanisms, and risk management infrastructure owned by the Corporation; 2. The Board of Directors understands that Risk Management is an integral part of GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) practices. Therefore, all development initiatives and implementations must be placed in the context of Integrated GRC; 3. Risk Management is carried out with the premise set out in the Corporation’s Long Term Plan (RJPP) based on values, goals and strategies with corporate risk management principles that are protective, value creating, transparent and inclusive; 712 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance 4. Manajemen Risiko merupakan bagian integral dari proses bisnis yang dilakukan secara sistematis, terstruktur dan tepat waktu berdasarkan informasi terbaik yang tersedia yang disesuaikan dengan kondisi internal dan eksternal Perseroan; 5. Manajemen Risiko adalah strategi utama dalam penentuan perencanaan strategis Perseroan, bukan hanya menjadi alat ukur kinerja operasional harian semata; 6. Manajemen Risiko dimulai dari integritas Direksi, dan dilakukan dengan prinsip efektivitas dan efisiensi dengan memperhatikan seluruh aspek risiko yang terdapat dalam Perseroan. Sehingga Manajemen Anti-Fraud (anti kecurangan), termasuk anti-bribery (anti penyuapan) menjadi hal yang wajib dilakukan, khusus untuk risiko yang berhubungan dengan integritas, Direksi tidak memberikan toleransi (zero tolerance).” 7. Manajemen Risiko menjamin seluruh laporan yang menyajikan pengukuran kinerja Perseroan (corporate performance). Hal tersebut dilakukan dengan penuh kehati-hatian (prudent), sehingga terhindar dari potensi fraud (kecurangan), termasuk bribery (penyuapan); 8. Manajemen Risiko mengutamakan faktor keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja serta lingkungan bagi Karyawan yang merupakan aset utama (human capital) yang dimiliki oleh Perseroan, termasuk keselamatan perkeretaapian yang mengutamakan stakeholder Perseroan; 4. Risk Management is an integral part of the business process conducted systematically, structured, and timely based on the best available information adapted to the Corporation’s internal and external conditions; 5. Risk Management is a key strategy in determining the Corporation’s strategic planning, not just a tool for measuring daily operational performance; 6. Risk Management starts from the integrity of the Board of Directors, conducted with principles of effectiveness and efficiency considering all aspects of risks within the Corporation. Therefore, anti-fraud management (anticorruption), including anti-bribery measures, are mandatory, especially for risks related to integrity, the Board of Directors does not tolerate (zero tolerance).
7. Risk Management ensures all reports present the Corporation’s performance measurements. These are carried out with prudence, thus, avoiding potential fraud, including bribery; 8. Mural di Terowongan Kendal Mural in Kendal Tunnel 715 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report MRT Jakarta berkomitmen untuk menerapkan governansi korporat. Salah satu bentuk komitmennya adalah memiliki Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku (Code of Conduct). Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku akan menjadi landasan bagi insan Perseroan dalam berinteraksi dengan stakeholders dan bertindak sesuai dengan nilai-nilai Perseroan. Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku (Code of Conduct) yang ditetapkan dalam Keputusan Bersama Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi No. 009 Tahun 2023 dan No. 062 Tahun 2023 tentang Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku (Code of Conduct). Visi, Misi, serta Tata Nilai Perseroan sebagai Dasar Utama Perseroan telah merumuskan dan menetapkan visi dan misi, sebagai dasar utama dalam arahan bagi pengembangan Perseroan ke depan. Visi dan misi tersebut kemudian diturunkan ke dalam nilai-nilai utama, yang diharapkan dapat dipahami sebagai kebijakan mendasar Perseroan untuk mengembangkan keorganisasian, yang sejalan dengan visi dan misi yang telah ditetapkan. Nilai-nilai utama inilah yang menjadi fondasi bagi Perseroan untuk merumuskan, mengembangkan, menerapkan, dan menegakkan kode etik dalam prinsip etika bisnis yang sehat.
Kode Etik Code of Conducts MRT Jakarta is committed to implementing corporate governance. One form of commitments is to have a Code of Conduct. The Code of Conduct will be the basis for the Corporation's employee in interacting with stakeholders and acting in accordance with the Corporation's values. The Code of Conduct is stipulated in the Joint Decision of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors No. 009 of 2023 and No. 062 of 2023 on the Code of Conduct.
Vision, Mission, and Corporate Values as the Main Foundation The Corporation has formulated and established its vision and mission, as the primary guidance for its future development. These vision and mission statements are then translated into core values expected to be understood as the fundamental policies for the Corporation’s development in line with the established vision and mission. These core values serve as the foundation for the Corporation to formulate, develop, implement, and uphold the code of conducts based on principles of sound business ethics.

Bab IX Penutup Surat Pernyataan Kepatuhan Code of Conduct Sosialisasi Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku Perseroan Informasi dan pengetahuan akan Code of Conduct dalam Perseroan telah dijadikan sebagai salah satu materi dalam pelatihan dasar karyawan bagi karyawan yang baru bergabung. Selain itu, seluruh tingkatan manajemen, Direksi dan pejabat struktural di unit kerja masing-masing juga diwajibkan, untuk memberikan pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai pokok-pokok Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku Perseroan kepada seluruh staf yang berada di bawahnya. Pada tahun 2024, Perseroan memiliki Guide to Code of Conduct 2024 yang digunakan untuk kebutuhan internal Perseroan.
Upaya Penegakan Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku bertujuan untuk memastikan bahwa insan Perseroan, selalu berperilaku sama baik di dalam Perseroan maupun saat berurusan di luar Perseroan. Untuk itu perlu dipastikan penegakan kepatuhan atas Pedoman. Apabila terdapat pelanggaran maka hal tersebut harus dilaporkan dengan memperhatikan hal-hal yang diatur sebagai berikut: 1. Tanggung Jawab; 2. Pelaporan Pelanggaran Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku; 3. Penanganan Pelaporan Dugaan Pelanggaran Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku; dan 4. Penghargaan dan Sanksi atas Pelanggaran Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku.
Chapter VI Enforcement and Reporting of Ethics and Conduct 1. Responsibility; 2. Reporting Violations of the Code of Ethics and Conduct; 3. Handling of Reporting of Alleged Violations of the Code of Ethics and Behaviour; and 4. Awards and Sanctions for Violations of the Code of Ethics and Conduct.
Chapter VII Measurement of Ethics and Behaviour 1. Survey Components; 2. Survey Design; 3. Survey Results; and 4. Method of Linking Ethics and Behaviour Measurement Results with Corporate Strategy Formulation.
Chapter VIII Care/Maintenance of the Implementation of the Code of Ethics and Conduct 1. New Employee Induction Programme; 2. Education and Training Continuity; and 3. Periodic Communication.
Chapter IX Closing Statement of Code of Conduct Compliance Dissemination of the Corporation’s Code of Conduct Information and knowledge of the Code of Conduct in the Corporation has been made as one of the materials in the employee basic training for new employees. In addition, all levels of management, Directors and structural officials in their respective work units are also required to provide an in-depth understanding of the Corporation’s Code of Conduct to all staff under them. In 2024, the Corporation has a Guide to Code of Conduct 2024 which is used for the Corporation’s internal needs.
Efforts to Enforce the Code of Ethics and Conduct The Code of Ethics and Conduct aims to ensure that the Corporation’s employee always behave the same, both within the Corporation and when dealing outside the Corporation. Therefore, it is necessary to ensure enforcement of compliance with the Code. If there is a violation, it must be reported by paying attention to the following matters: 1. Responsibility; 2. Reporting Violations of the Code of Ethics and Conduct; 3. Handling of Reporting of Alleged Violations of the Code of Ethics and Behaviour; and 4. Awards and Sanctions for Violations of the Code of Ethics and Conduct.

Pengungkapan Kepatuhan Bahwa Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku Berlaku Bagi Seluruh Level Organisasi Bagi Perseroan, Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku merupakan wujud kepatuhan terhadap ketentuan hukum dan standar etika tertinggi, di mana saja Perseroan melakukan kegiatan bisnis/operasionalnya. Selain mengikuti Peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, Perseroan juga harus menjunjung tinggi norma dan etika. Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku berlaku bagi seluruh insan MRT Jakarta, yaitu Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan seluruh karyawan. Seluruh insan Perseroan mempunyai kesadaran untuk menjalankan etika yang baik akan meningkatkan dan memperkuat reputasi Perseroan.

Sanksi juga diberikan kepada insan Perseroan yang terbukti menyampaikan laporan palsu dan/atau fitnah. Pemberian sanksi mengacu kepada peraturan Perseroan. In addition to following the prevailing laws and regulations, the Corporation must also uphold norms and ethics. The Code of Ethics and Conduct applies to all MRT Jakarta employee, namely the Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, and all employees. All of the Corporation’s employee have an awareness that practicing good ethics will improve and strengthen the Corporation’s reputation.

Pengelolaan SDM merupakan kunci dalam pencapaian tujuan Perseroan Human Resource Management is the key to achieving the Corporation's goals 723 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Sistem Pelaporan Pelanggaran adalah sistem pencegahan dan identifikasi terhadap fraud atau tindakan penyimpangan atau pembiaran yang disengaja. Manajemen Perseroan memiliki komitmen yang kuat, bersikap independen, serta bebas intervensi dalam melaksanakan WBS. Kecukupan dan efektivitas pelaksanaan WBS diawasi oleh Dewan Komisaris.
Sistem Pelaporan Pelanggaran telah ditetapkan melalui Peraturan Direksi No. 25 Tahun 2023 tentang Pedoman Sistem Pelaporan Dugaan Pelanggaran (Whistleblowing System). Keterbukaan saluran WBS yang disampaikan kepada seluruh pemangku kepentingan menunjukkan niat besar Perseroan untuk dapat melibatkan pemangku kepentingan dalam penegakan prinsip GCG.
Sistem Pelaporan Dugaan Pelanggaran (Whistleblowing System) Whistleblowing System The Whistleblowing System is a system of prevention and identification of fraud or deliberate acts of deviation or omission. The Corporation's management has a strong commitment, is independent, and free from intervention in implementing the WBS. The adequacy and effectiveness of the WBS implementation is supervised by the Board of Commissioners.
The Whistleblowing System has been established through the Board of Directors Regulation No. 25 of 2023 on Guidelines for the Whistleblowing System. The openness of the WBS channel to all stakeholders shows the Corporation's great intention to involve stakeholders in upholding GCG principles.

Whistleblower may choose to submit the report anonymously Pelapor mengakses saluran WBS Perseroan Whistleblower accesses the Corporate WBS channel Pelapor mengakses WBS melalui website Perseroan atau email Whistleblower accesses WBS through website or email 725 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Perlindungan bagi Pelapor PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) berkomitmen untuk melindungi pelaporan pelanggaran yang beritikad baik, patuh terhadap segala peraturan dan perundang-undangan serta best practices yang berlaku dalam penyelenggaraan WBS.
Kebijakan perlindungan tarhadap pelapor adalah sebagai berikut: 1. Identitas pelapor dijamin kerahasiaannya oleh Perusahaan; 2. Perusahaan menjamin perlindungan terhadap pelapor dari segala bentuk ancaman, intimidasi, ataupun tindakan tidak menyenangkan dari pihak manapun selama pelapor menjaga kerahasiaan pelanggaran yang diadukan kepada pihak manapun; 3. Perlindungan terhadap pelapor juga berlaku bagi para pihak yang melaksanakan pemeriksaan maupun para pihak yang memberikan informasi terkait dengan pengaduan tersebut; dan 4. Pelapor tidak dikriminalisasi akibat penyampaian laporannya, sepanjang yang disampaikan bukan merupakan laporan palsu dan/atau fitnah. Pembuktian laporan palsu dan/atau fitnah akan dilakukan melalui proses investigasi yang dilakukan oleh Divisi Internal Audit. Perlindungan yang diberikan PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) adalah perlindungan terhadap: 1. Pemecatan yang tidak adil; 2. Penurunan jabatan atau pangkat; 3. Pelecehan dan/atau diskriminasi dan/atau tekanan dan/atau intimidasi dalam segala bentuknya; 4. Catatan yang merugikan dalam dokumen data pribadinya; 5. Perbuatan diskriminasi dalam pengembangan karir di Perusahaan; dan 6. Pelapor mendapatkan proses counseling/trauma healing bila dipandang perlu berdasarkan diagnosa ahli.
Penanganan Pengaduan Pengelolaan sistem Whistleblowing System di Perseroan dilakukan sesuai dengan tata cara dan prosedur pelaporan yang telah ditetapkan. Pengelolaan WBS meliputi kegiatan penanganan laporan, investigasi laporan, hingga penindakan terhadap terlapor apabila terbukti terjadi pelanggaran etika bisnis dan etika kerja.
Whistleblower Protection PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) is committed to protecting good faith whistleblowers, complying with all applicable laws and regulations and best practices in the implementation of WBS.
The whistleblower protection policy is as follows: 1. The Corporation guarantees the confidentiality of the whistleblowers’ identities; 2. The Corporation guarantees protection for whistleblowers from all forms of threats, intimidations, or unpleasant actions from any party as long as the whistleblowers maintain the secrecy of the reported violations from any party; 3. Protection for whistleblowers also applies to parties who carry out the investigation and parties who provide information on the Report; and 4. The whistleblower is not criminalized due to the submission of his/her report, as long as what is submitted is not a false and/or slanderous report. Proof of false and/or defamatory reports will be carried out through an investigation process conducted by the Internal Audit Division.
The protection provided by PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) is protection against: 1. Unfair dismissal; 2. Demotion of position or rank; 3. Harassment and/or discrimination and/or threats and/or intimidation in any form; 4. Adverse records in the personal data documents; 5. Discrimination in terms of career development in the Corporation; and 6. Whistleblowers may be provided with counseling/ trauma healing process if deemed necessary based on a diagnosis of an Expert.
Complaint Handling The management of WBS system in the Corporation is carried out in accordance with the established procedures and reporting procedures. WBS management includes report handling activities, report investigation, and action against the reported party if there is a proven violation of business ethics and work ethics.

Komite WBS terdiri dari Kepala Divisi Corporate Secretary, Kepala Divisi Internal Audit, dan Kepala Divisi Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance. Komite WBS bertugas untuk memberikan saran tindak lanjut atas laporan yang masuk di kanal WBS.
ORGANISASI PELAKSANA SISTEM PELAPORAN DUGAAN PELANGGARAN ORGANIZATION OF WHISTLEBLOWING SYSTEM ADMINISTRATOR Organisasi Organization Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Duties and Responsibilities Komite Penanganan Pelaporan Dugaan Pelanggaran Whistleblowing Handling Committee • Menugaskan Divisi Internal Audit membentuk Tim Penelitian Awal untuk melakukan Audit Investigatif 4W+1H atas laporan WBS; • Menilai laporan Tim Penelitian Awal, apakah telah menjelaskan pemenuhan 4W+1H atau belum, agar dapat dilanjutkan ke tahapan selanjutnya; • Melaporkan hasil validasi data/informasi laporan sistem pelaporan dugaan pelanggaran kepada Direktur Utama (jika terlapor adalah selain Direksi), Komisaris Utama (jika terlapor adalah Direksi atau Komite Dewan Komisaris), atau Pemegang Saham (jika terlapor adalah anggota Dewan Komisaris) untuk diputuskan, apakah laporan dapat dilanjutkan ke tahap selanjutnya atau tidak; • Mereviu laporan hasil penelitian awal yang dilakukan oleh Tim Penelitian Awal, Tim Audit Investigatif, dan/atau Tim Pemeriksa Eksternal; dan • Membuat laporan akhir pelaporan sistem pelaporan dugaan pelanggaran dan menyampaikannya kepada Direktur Utama/Komisaris Utama.
• Assigning Internal Audit Division to establish Initial Investigation Team to carry out Investigative Audit 4W+1H for WBS reports; • Assessing the report from the Initial Investigation Team, whether it elaborates the fulfillment of 4W+1H or not, to be proceeded to the next step; • Reporting the results of data/information validation from the Whistleblowing System to the President Director (if the reported is not the Board of Directors), President Commissioner (if the reported is the Board of Directors or the Board of Commissioners Committee), or Shareholders (if the reported is the Board of Commissioners) to be decided whether the report can be processed to the next step; • Reviewing the report of the initial investigation carried out by the Initial Investigation Team, Investigative Audit Team, and/or External Auditor Team; and • Creating the final report of the whistleblowing system report and presenting the report to the President Director/ the President Commissioner.
Divisi Internal Audit Internal Audit Division • Merupakan Tim Penelitian Awal dan Tim Audit Investigatif; • Mengeluarkan surat tugas kepada anggota Divisi Internal Audit yang akan menjadi Tim Penelitian Awal; • Melakukan Audit Investigatif untuk menilai pemenuhan 4W+1H terhadap laporan WBS dan melanjutkan proses Audit Investigatif terhadap laporan WBS yang telah disetujui oleh Direktur Utama/Komisaris Utama/Pemegang Saham untuk diproses ke tahap selanjutnya; • Membuat laporan hasil Audit Investigatif dan melaporkannya kepada Komite Penanganan Pelaporan Dugaan Pelanggaran; dan • Menyusun dan memasukkan anggaran tahunan Tim Pemeriksa Eksternal ke dalam RKAP .
• Being the Initial Investigation Team and Investigative Audit Team; • Issuing letter of assignment to the member of Internal Audit Division to be a member of Initial Investigation Team; • Carrying out the Investigative Audit to assess the fulfillment of 4W+1H of the WBS report and Proceeding Investigative Audit to WBS reports approved by the President Director/PresidentCommissioner/Shareholder to be processed in the next step; • Creating the report of Investigative Audit results and reporting it to Whistleblowing Handling Committee; and • Compiling and including the annual budget of the External Auditor Team to the RKAP .
Tim Pemeriksa Eksternal External Auditor Team • Merupakan pihak independen yang melakukan Audit Investigatif terhadap laporan WBS yang telah memenuhi validasi data atau unsur- unsur 4W+1H, dan jika terlapor adalah karyawan Divisi Internal Audit atau jika dibutuhkan oleh Tim Audit Investigatif Divisi Internal Audit; dan • Merupakan pihak independen yang dibutuhkan keahliannya atau akses khususnya terhadap informasi yang dapat membantu memperlancar Audit Investigatif yang dilakukan Tim Internal Audit.
• Being an independent party to carry out an Investigative Audit on WBS report that has fulfilled data validation or 4W+1H elements, and if the report is a member of the Internal Audit Division of as required by the Investigative Audit Team of the Internal Audit Division; and • Being an independent party whose expertise or special access to information is required to help the investigative Audit carried out by the Internal Audit Team.
Parties Managing the Complaint The Board of Directors established the WBS Committee to manage complaints. The WBS Committee consists of the Head of Corporate Secretary Division, Head of Internal Audit Division, and Head of Enterprise Risk Management and Assurance Division. The WBS Committee is tasked with providing follow-up advice on reports submitted to the WBS channel.

• Dismissing the member of the Whistleblowing Handling Committee if the relevant member is the reported in WBS Report and appointing another Division Head without potential conflict of interest with the reported; and • Deciding whether a report can be processed to the next step, in the event that the reported is an employee of the Corporation, based on the report from the Whistleblowing Handling Committee.
Komisaris Utama President Commissioner • Memutuskan apakah laporan dapat dilanjutkan ke tahap selanjutnya atau tidak, dalam hal Terlapor merupakan anggota Direksi/anggota Komite Dewan Komisaris yang bukan berasal dari anggota Dewan Komisaris, berdasarkan laporan dari Komite Penanganan Pelaporan Dugaan Pelanggaran.
• Deciding whether a report can be processed in the next step, in the event that the Reported is a member of the Board of Directors or a member of the Committee of the Board of Commissioners, based on the report from the Whistleblowing Handling Committee.
Pemegang Saham Shareholders • Memutuskan apakah laporan dapat dilanjutkan ke tahap selanjutnya atau tidak? Dalam hal Terlapor merupakan anggota Dewan Komisaris, berdasarkan laporan dari Komite Penanganan Pelaporan Dugaan Pelanggaran.
• Deciding whether a report can be processed in the next step? In the event that the Reported is a member of the Board of Commissioners, based on the report from Whistleblowing Handling Committee.

Of the 18 reports related to WBS, 13 reports had been completed, 1 completed and proven, and 4 had not been completed.
Follow-up on Complaints in 2024 For complaints that were proven, the Corporation had imposed sanctions in accordance with the Corporation Regulations applicable in the Corporation including the provision of a Letter of Reprimand, refund, and improvement of governance.
728 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Mekanisme Whistleblowing System Penerapan WBS MRT Jakarta dikelola oleh pihak independen, dan diawasi oleh Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi yang mengacu kepada Peraturan Direksi No. 028 Tahun 2024 tentang Pedoman Sistem Pelaporan Dugaan Pelanggaran (Whistleblowing System). Penerapan pedoman tersebut telah dilaksanakan secara efektif di Perseroan.

The implementation of these guidelines had been effectively implemented in the Corporation.
Communication Media in Delivering Whistleblowing System Whistleblowers can use the facilities that have been provided, namely: Website : https://whistleblowing.tips/wbs/@MRTJakarta Email : WBS.MRTJakarta@rsm.id SMS/Whatsapp : 0811170636 (http://wa.me/62811170636) PO BOX : PO BOX 1036 Jakarta 12036 729 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Perseroan menetapkan Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku yang salah satu isinya mengenai komitmen terhadap penerapan Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuapan. Program Penanganan Antikorupsi Perseroan mengimplementasikan SNI ISO 37001 tentang Sistem Manajemen Anti Penyuapan. Terkait dengan implementasi standar baru tersebut, Perseroan telah melakukan penyesuaian terhadap kebijakan internal, yang terkait dengan upaya untuk menciptakan organisasi yang bersih dan bebas KKN. Perseroan juga bekerja sama dengan Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK), di antaranya dalam hal peningkatan kesadaran antikorupsi melalui pelaksanaan sosialisasi antikorupsi dan anti-gratifikasi kepada seluruh insan Perseroan.
Sosialisasi Antikorupsi Sepanjang tahun 2024, Perseroan melakukan sosialisasi atas kebijakan-kebijakan yang mendukung gerakan antikorupsi kepada seluruh karyawan, melalui sosialisasi langsung dan berbagai media komunikasi internal Perseroan, baik melalui email, kinetic, successfactor maupun media sosialisasi lainnya secara intensif.
Kebijakan Untuk Mencegah Terjadinya Insider Trading Policies to Prevent Insider Trading Perseroan bukan merupakan Perusahaan Publik sehingga tidak terdapat kebijakan terkait insider trading.
Kebijakan Antikorupsi Anti-Corruption Policy As the Corporation is not a Public Corporation, there are no policies related to insider trading.
The Corporation has established a Code of Conduct, which includes a commitment to implementing an Anti-Bribery Management System.
Anti-Corruption Handling Program The Corporation implements SNI ISO 37001 on the Anti-Bribery Management System. In line with the implementation of this new standard, the Corporation has adjusted its internal policies to support efforts in creating a clean and corruption, collusion, and nepotism (KKN)-free organization. The Corporation also collaborates with the Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK), particularly in raising anti-corruption awareness through the dissemination of anti-corruption and anti-gratification education to all employees.
Anti-Corruption Dissemination Throughout 2024, the Corporation organized awareness campaigns on policies supporting the anti-corruption movement for all employees through direct dissemination and various internal communication channels, including email, kinetic, successfactor, and other corporate-wide communication channels intensively.

E-mail blast, Karyawan E-mail blast, Employees 30 Desember 2024 December 30, 2024 Divisi Internal Audit Internal Audit Division Pengendalian Gratifikasi Perseroan telah menetapkan Pedoman Pengendalian Gratifikasi berdasarkan Peraturan Direksi No. 16 Tahun 2024. Pedoman ini mengatur batasan-batasan pemberian, penerimaan, dan penolakan gratifikasi oleh Insan MRT Jakarta beserta ketentuan pengendalian gratifikasi di lingkungan Perseroan antara lain tata cara pelaporan kepada Unit Pengendali Gratifikasi (UPG). Pedoman pengendalian gratifikasi telah diunggah ke dalam website dan portal internal Perseroan. Unit pengendali gratifikasi (UPG) sebagai pengelola laporan gratifikasi, menerima laporan penerimaan/penolakan gratifikasi, yang disampaikan oleh Insan MRT Jakarta. UPG berada di bawah Divisi Internal Audit yang bertugas dan bertanggung jawab dalam implementasi serta pengelolaan gratifikasi.
Gratification Control The Corporation has established the Gratification Control Guidelines based on Board of Directors Regulation No. 16 of 2024. These guidelines regulate the limitations on giving, receiving, and rejecting gratuities by MRT Jakarta employee, as well as the provisions for gratification control within the Corporation, including the reporting procedures to the Gratification Control Unit (UPG). The Gratification Control Guidelines have been uploaded to the Corporation’s website and internal portal. As the administrator of gratification reports, UPG receives reports on the acceptance or rejection of gratuities submitted by MRT Jakarta employee. UPG operates under the Internal Audit Division, which is responsible for the implementation and management of gratification control.

Business Administration, Engineering. dan Teknik Sipil Business Administration, Engineering and Civil Engineering 742 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Pengukuran Penerapan GCG Untuk Mewujudkan Praktik Terbaik Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik 1. Penilaian Penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang baik berdasarkan metode penilaian self-assessment dengan dukungan pihak eksternal; 2. Penilaian Corporate Governance Perception Index (CGPI) berdasarkan metode penilaian dari The Indonesia Institute for Corporate Governance (IICG) oleh IICG sebagai Pihak Independen; dan 3. Pengukuran maturitas penerapan GRC Terintegrasi berdasarkan kerangka GRC capability model dari OCEG.
Penilaian Penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik Upaya yang dilakukan Perseroan untuk terus meningkatkan kualitas penerapan GCG adalah dengan melakukan penilaian penerapan GCG secara berkala. Langkah ini dilakukan agar Perseroan dapat memperoleh gambaran yang lebih jelas, terkait kelebihan dan kekurangan dalam penerapan GCG di lingkungan Perseroan. Penerapan atas Pedoman Tata Kelola Perusahaan Implementation of the Corporate Governance Guidelines Measurement of GCG Implementation to Realize the Best Practices of Good Corporate Governance 1. Assessment of Good Corporate Governance (GCG) implementation based on the self-assessment method with support from external parties; 2. Corporate Governance Perception Index (CGPI) assessment based on the evaluation method from The Indonesia Institute for Corporate Governance (IICG) conducted by IICG as an independent party; and 3. Measurement of the maturity level of integrated GRC implementation based on the GRC capability model framework from OCEG.
Assessment of the Implementation of Good Corporate Governance The Corporation's efforts to continuously improve the quality of GCG implementation include conducting GCG assessments regularly. This step is taken to provide the Corporation with a clearer understanding of the strengths and weaknesses in GCG implementation within its environment.

The assessment indicators cover five testing aspects and are conducted through a review of document completeness as well as interviews with several internal parties of the Corporation. The assessment results are scored on a scale of up to 100, based on the defined evaluation criteria.
The parameters for GCG implementation assessment based on BPKP evaluation include the following aspects: 1. Commitment; 2. Policy; 3. Good Corporate Governance Participants: a. Shareholders; b. Board Commissioners; c. Board of Commissioners’ Committees; d. Board of Directors; e. Internal Control Unit; and f. Corporate Secretary.
4. Disclosure of Information; and 5. Others.

The Corporation had not yet established a policy regarding the obligation of the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners, to create an integrity pact for each significant transaction that requires approval and/or input from the Board of Commissioners and approval from Shareholders.

Selain melakukan asesmen GCG berdasarkan Metode penilaian self-assessment, Perseroan juga menggunakan penilaian Indeks Persepsi Tata Kelola atau Corporate Governance Perception Index (CGPI) yang dilakukan oleh The Indonesia Institute for Corporate Governance (IICG). CGPI merupakan program pemeringkatan praktik GCG dengan menggunakan pendekatan tematik yang menyesuaikan dengan perkembangan bisnis. Program ini merupakan program tahunan yang menilai implementasi GCG dengan rentang waktu satu tahun penuh. Metode penilaian yang dikembangkan IICG ini meliputi struktur tata kelola, proses tata kelola, dan hasil tata kelola.
Aspek penilaian CGPI meliputi struktur tata kelola, proses tata kelola, dan hasil tata kelola. Hasil penilaian CGPI berupa rentang skor yang dicapai oleh peserta, dengan kategorisasi atas tingkat kualitas implementasi Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang baik dengan menggunakan istilah “Cukup”, “Tepercaya”, dan “Sangat Tepercaya”.
ASPEK PENILAIAN CGPI OLEH IICG CGPI ASSESSMENT ASPECT BY IICG Struktur Tata Kelola Governance Structure Proses Tata Kelola Governance Process Hasil Tata Kelola Governance Outcome 01 01 03 03 02 02 Pada tahun 2024, PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) mengikuti ajang Penghargaan Tata Kelola Perusahaan (Corporate Governance Perception Index). Perseroan memperoleh skor 84,85 dengan kategori “Tepercaya” dalam penerapan Tata Kelola Perusahaan dalam tahun buku 2023.
Assessment of the Corporate Governance Perception Index (CGPI) Based on the Evaluation Method of The Indonesia Institute for Corporate Governance (IICG) MRT Jakarta believes that the implementation of good governance is the fundamental foundation for the Corporation to achieve better performance, enhance MRT Jakarta’s value, and ensure the fulfillment of stakeholders’ rights, ultimately creating a sustainable MRT Jakarta business. In addition to conducting GCG assessments based on the self-assessment method, the Corporation also utilizes the Corporate Governance Perception Index (CGPI) assessment conducted by The Indonesia Institute for Corporate Governance (IICG). CGPI is a GCG practice ranking program that employs a thematic approach, aligning with business developments. This program is an annual initiative that evaluates GCG implementation over a full-year period. The assessment method developed by IICG covers governance structure, governance processes, and governance outcomes.
The CGPI assessment aspects include governance structure, governance processes, and governance outcomes. The CGPI assessment results are presented as a score range achieved by participants, categorized into different levels of good Corporate Governance quality using the terms “Fair,” “Trusted,” and “Most Trusted.” In 2024, PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) participated in the Corporate Governance Perception Index. The Corporation obtained a score of 84.85 under “Trusted” category in the implementation of Corporate Governance in the 2023 financial year.

The Corporation also conducts regular dissemination and evaluation of its compliance system.
5. MRT Jakarta perlu mengoptimalkan penguatan kualitas, kapasitas, dan kapabilitas SDM yang selalu siap beradaptasi secara cepat, akurat dan tepat dengan dinamika perubahan; bersemangat dan lincah; serta dilengkapi dengan sertifikasi kompetensi yang sesuai; MRT Jakarta needs to strengthen the quality, capacity, and capability of human resources, ensuring they are always ready to adapt quickly, accurately, and effectively to dynamic changes; remain agile and motivated; and are equipped with the appropriate competency certifications; Perseroan telah mengatur perihal optimalisasi penguatan kualitas, kapasitas dan kapabilitas SDM dalam Peraturan Direksi 056/BOD-MRT/XII/2023 terkait Pedoman Pembelajaran dan Pengembangan Karyawan. Perseroan juga menyediakan platform belajar secara online untuk dapat diakses dalam hal peningkatan kapasitas dan kapabilitas SDM. The Corporation has established regulations for optimizing the quality, capacity, and capability of human resources through Board of Directors Regulation No. 056/BOD-MRT/ XII/2023 on Employee Learning and Development Guidelines. Additionally, the Corporation provides an online learning platform to facilitate HR capacity and capability enhancement.
6. MRT Jakarta perlu mengembangkan evaluasi pengukuran kematangan sistem tata kelola human capital yang dapat mendukung pengelolaan SDM yang selaras dengan strategi Perseroan, serta menjadikan Perseroan sesuai standar best practice internasional; MRT Jakarta needs to develop an evaluation framework for measuring the maturity of the human capital governance system that can support HR management that aligns with the Corporation’s strategy and meets international best practice standards; Pada tahun 2024, Perseroan melakukan pengukuran/audit kinerja SDM melalui dua badan eksternal, yaitu: 1. Lembaga Top Business melakukan audit kinerja SDM dan mendapatkan penilaian Star 4; 2. Lembaga GML Consulting melakukan audit kinerja SDM dan mendapatkan penilaian Stellar Workplace Recognizition in Employee Satisfaction dan Stellar Workplace Recognizition in Employee Commitment. In 2024, the Corporation conducted an HR performance assessment/audit through two external institutions, namely: 1. Top Business Institution conducted an HR performance audit and awarded a 4-Star rating.
2. GML Consulting conducted an HR performance audit and granted Stellar Workplace Recognition in Employee Satisfaction and Stellar Workplace Recognition in Employee Commitment.
7. MRT Jakarta perlu mengembangkan struktur dan sistem terkait perlindungan dan pemberdayaan konsumen yang andal dan melakukan evaluasi pelaksanaannya secara berkala; dan MRT Jakarta needs to develop a reliable structure and system for consumer protection and empowerment and conduct regular evaluations of its implementation; and Perseroan memiliki Peraturan Direksi PER/013/BOD-MRT/ IV/2023 terkait Pedoman Perjanjian Angkutan dengan Penumpang, di mana Penumpang bertiket yang telah masuk dalam area berbayar telah mendapat perlindungan asuransi dan jaminan pertanggungjawaban kecelakaan. Selain itu Perseroan juga memiliki kanal Sosial Media sehingga penumpang dapat memberikan feedback langsung dan akan di evaluasi secara berkala oleh Manajemen. The Corporation has issued Board of Directors Regulation No. PER/013/BOD-MRT/IV/2023 on Guidelines for Passenger Transport Agreements, ensuring that ticketed passengers who have entered the paid area are covered by insurance and accident liability protection. Additionally, the Corporation maintains social media channels that allow passengers to provide direct feedback, which is regularly evaluated by Management.
761 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Rekomendasi Recommendation Tindak Lanjut yang Telah Dilaksanakan/ Rencana Tindak Lanjut Follow-Up Actions That Have Been Implemented/ Follow-Up Plans 8. MRT Jakarta perlu menjaga kehandalan dan tingkat keamanan terhadap data, network, sistem dan teknologi informasi yang digunakan sehingga terbebas dari risiko peretasan dan penggunaan data oleh pihak-pihak yang tidak berkepentingan; MRT Jakarta must ensure the reliability and security of data, networks, systems, and information technology, protecting them from hacking risks and unauthorized data usage; Perseroan sudah memiliki Peraturan Direksi Nomor 5 Tahun 2022 tentang Pedoman dan Kebijakan Sistem Manajemen Keamanan Informasi, berbasis ISO 27001:2016, di mana setiap tahun dilakukan Audit Internal secara keseluruhan terkait implementasi Pedoman dan Kebijakan Tersebut. Selain itu, Divisi IST secara rutin melakukan security hardening (Penguatan Keamanan) sistem yang digunakan di lingkungan Perseroan The Corporation has also implemented Board of Directors Regulation No. 5 of 2022 on Information Security Management System Guidelines and Policies, based on ISO 27001:2016, where internal audit is conducted annually to assess the implementation of these guidelines and policies. Furthermore, the IST Division routinely performs security hardening to enhance the security of the systems used within the Corporation.
Aspek Hasil Tata Kelola (Governance Outcome) Governance Outcome Aspect 1. MRT Jakarta perlu meningkatkan pertumbuhan nilai, untuk Pemegang Saham melalui peningkatan dividen secara konsisten dan proporsional bagi seluruh Pemegang Saham; MRT Jakarta needs to improve shareholder value growth by consistently and proportionally increasing dividends for all shareholders; Perseroan saat ini masih belum membagikan dividen secara konsisten, namun Perseroan memberikan kontribusi dalam Pendapatan Asli Daerah melalui advertising. The Corporation has not yet distributed dividends consistently; however, it contributes to Regional Original Revenue (PAD) through advertising.
2. MRT Jakarta perlu mengembangkan program penilaian dan program pemantauan, agar seluruh Direksi, Dewan Komisaris, serta seluruh karyawan Perseroan memahami kode etik yang relevan dan menerapkannya secara efektif untuk menghindari keterlibatan korporasi dalam perilaku yang tidak tepat; MRT Jakarta should develop evaluation and monitoring programs to ensure that the Board of Directors, Board of Commissioners, and all employees understand the relevant code of ethics and apply it effectively, preventing the Corporation from engaging in inappropriate behavior; Perseroan memiliki Pedoman Etika dan Perilaku (Code of Conduct) SK/009/BOC-MRT/X/2023 dan SK/062/BOD-MRT/X/2023 serta telah dilakukan sosialisasi setiap tahunnya agar penerapan kode etik dapat efektif untuk menghindari keterlibatan korporasi dalam perilaku yang tidak tepat. The Corporation has established the Code of Conduct Guidelines under SK/009/BOC-MRT/X/2023 and SK/062/ BOD-MRT/X/2023 and conducts annual dissemination efforts to ensure the effective implementation of the code of ethics, preventing the Corporation from engaging in inappropriate behavior.
3. MRT Jakarta perlu menumbuhkan budaya tangguh dan tangkas dengan kemampuan untuk cepat beradaptasi dan merespon perubahan serta mengelola tantangan agar dapat menjadi peluang untuk bersaing; dan MRT Jakarta needs to foster a resilient and agile corporate culture, enabling the organization to adapt quickly, respond to changes, and manage challenges effectively, turning them into opportunities for competition; and Perseroan telah melakukan pengembangan modul Business Continuity Management yang bekerja sama dengan SMI, serta mengimplementasi modul melalui Online Course Platform yang diperuntukkan Staff sampai dengan Section Head. The Corporation has developed a Business Continuity Management module in collaboration with SMI and has implemented it through an Online Course Platform, designed for staff up to the Section Head level.
4. MRT Jakarta perlu meningkatkan capaian inovasi bisnis Perseroan menjadi yang terbaik tidak hanya pada produk dan layanan namun juga pada proses, fungsi pendukung, kinerja organisasi atau strategi sehingga menjadi keunggulan bersaing Perseroan serta menjaga nilai Perseroan untuk tumbuh berkelanjutan. MRT Jakarta should enhance business innovation achievements, ensuring excellence not only in products and services but also in processes, support functions, organizational performance, and strategy. This will strengthen the Corporation’s competitive advantage and sustain its long-term value growth.
Perseroan memiliki sejumlah inovasi, yang di dalamnya terdapat target capaian, sebagaimana tercantum dalam roadmap. Untuk mencapai target tersebut, terdapat program-program tahunan CABIN yang bersifat strategis. The Corporation has a number of innovations, which includes target achievements as outlined in the roadmap. To meet these targets, CABIN has strategic annual programs.

Dalam mengukur tingkat maturitas, MRT Jakarta menggunakan kriteria GRC Capability Model 3.0 yang dikembangkan oleh OCEG. Sejak tahun 2021, MRT Jakarta telah melakukan penilaian atas kematangan implementasi GRC Terintegrasi.
Pada tahun 2024, MRT Jakarta menggunakan kriteria GRC Capability Model 3.5 dengan mengembangkan unified integrated instrument berdasarkan OCEG. Unified integrated instrument mencakup GRC Terintegrasi, Manajemen Risiko, Compliance, serta BCM untuk mengurangi fatigue pengukuran di setiap tahunnya. Dengan mengintegrasikan fungsi-fungsi GRC, MRT Jakarta dapat meningkatkan kemampuan dalam mengelola GRC dan mencapai tujuan dengan lebih efektif dan efisien.
Measuring the Maturity of Integrated Implementation of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) by Independent Party Based on the GRC Capability Model from OCEG The Corporation conducts an Integrated GRC Assessment to evaluate the effectiveness of risk management, compliance with regulatory and standards, and corporate governance. To measure maturity levels, MRT Jakarta uses the GRC Capability Model 3.0 developed by OCEG. Since 2021, MRT Jakarta has been assessing the maturity of Integrated GRC implementation.
In 2024, MRT Jakarta adopted the GRC Capability Model 3.5 by developing a unified integrated instrument based on OCEG which consists of Integrated GRC, Risk Management, Compliance, and BCM, aiming to reduce assessment fatigue each year. By integrating GRC functions, MRT Jakarta enhances its ability to manage GRC and achieve its objectives more effectively and efficiently.
763 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report GRC Capability Model 3.5 terdiri dari 4 komponen kapabilitas. Setiap komponen kapabilitas terdiri dari beberapa elemen yang lebih spesifik, sehingga total terdapat 20 elemen di dalam GRC Capability Model 3.5.
GRC CAPABILITY MODEL ELEMENT VIEW LEARN L1 EXTERNAL CONTEXT L2 INTERNAL CONTEXT L3 CULTURE L4 STAKEHOLDERS REVIEW R1 MONITORING R2 ASSURANCE R3 IMPROVEMENT ALIGN A1 DIRECTION A2 OBJECTIVES A3 IDENTIFICATION A4 ASSESSMENT A5 DESIGN PERFORM P1 CONTROLS P2 POLICIES P3 COMMUNICATION P4 EDUCATION P5 INCENTIVES P6 NOTIFICATION P7 INQUIRY P8 RESPONSE Non existent (0): • Praktik GRC tidak dilaksanakan Non existent (0): • GRC practices are not implemented Initial (1): • Dilaksanakan tanpa mengikuti panduan atau pola tertentu • Pelaksanaan bersifat ad hoc, aktif, atas inisiatif peroragangan Initial (1): • Carried out without following specific guidelines or patterns • Implementation is ad hoc, active, based on individual initiative Repeatable (2): • Dilaksanakan secara berulang • Belum menjadi aturan baku • Cenderung tidak teroganisir Repeatable (2): • Carried out repeatedly • Not yet a standard rule • Tends to be disorganized Managed (4): • Perbaikan berkesinanmbungan • Sejalan dengan best practices • Diartikan juga sebagai capable Managed (4): • Continuous improvement • In line with best practices • Also interpreted as capable Optimized (5): • Perbaikan secara berkesinambungan • Layak dijadikan tolok ukur/competitive advantage • Mengikuti leading practice/berkelas dunia Optimized (5): • Continuous improvement • Worthy of being used as a benchmark/ competitive advantage • Following leading practices/individual world-class Defined (3): • Praktik GRC sudah dituangkan dalam bentuk kebijakan dan/atau prosedur standar • Dibangun dengan mengacu pada good practices Defined (3): • GRC practices have been outlined in the form of policies and/or standard procedures • Formed with reference to good practices The GRC Capability Model 3.5 consists of four capability components, each containing multiple specific elements, totaling 20 elements in the GRC Capability Model 3.5.

Dalam era globalisasi dan digital saat ini, keandalan Teknologi Informasi dan Komunikasi (TIK) merupakan salah satu unsur penting yang mendukung proses bisnis dan layanan yang prima. Teknologi Informasi dan Komunikasi (TIK) merupakan kunci utama yang memungkinkan Perseroan melakukan efisiensi, mengukur dan menelusuri kinerja bisnis, serta mengambil keputusan-keputusan manajemen yang tepat untuk kelangsungan usaha.
Tata Kelola Teknologi Informasi dan Komunikasi Information and Communication Technology Governance The evolving needs of business, operations, and organization, along with innovations in information technology in this current digital era, require the Corporation to organize and prepare the necessary technology to support business development and expansion. This also enables the Corporation to provide the best services and solutions to customers through reliable, technology-based services that offer added value and strategic solutions. In this current era of globalization and digital transformation, the reliability of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) is a key element in ensuring optimal business processes and high-quality services. ICT serves as a critical enabler that allows the Corporation to enhance efficiency, measure, and track business performance, and make appropriate management decisions to ensure business continuity.
Pemantauan pengoperasian MRT Jakarta Monitoring of MRT Jakarta’s operation 769 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Kebijakan dan Kelembagaan Teknologi Informasi dan Komunikasi Regulasi kebijakan TIK Perseroan: 1. Surat Edaran Kementerian Informasi dan Komunikasi No. 05/SE/M.Kominfo/07/2011 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola Keamanan Informasi bagi Penyelenggara Pelayanan Publik; 2. Keputusan Gubernur Provinsi DKI Jakarta No. 96 Tahun 2004 tentang Penerapan Praktik Good Corporate Governance pada BUMD di Lingkungan Provinsi DKI Jakarta; 3. Keputusan Bersama Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi PT MRT Jakarta No. 007 Tahun 2023/No. 060 Tahun 2023 tentang Pedoman Governansi Korporate (Tata Kelola Perusahaan) di Lingkungan PT MRT Jakarta; 4. Peraturan Direksi No. 060 Tahun 2023 tentang Pedoman Tata Kelola Teknologi dan Informasi di Lingkungan PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda); dan 5. Keputusan Direksi No. 042 Tahun 2023 tentang Pembentukan Komite Transformasi Digital (TDI).
Tujuan kebijakan TIK Perseroan: 1. Merupakan pokok-pokok penerapan pengelolaan Teknologi dan Informasi untuk memitigasi risiko yang akan muncul, dengan memperhatikan kompleksitas usaha Korporasi dan penerapan best practices yang berlaku; 2. Memberikan arahan agar pelaksanaan pengelolaan Teknologi dan Informasi yang dilakukan sesuai dengan prinsip dasar pengelolaan teknologi dan prinsip kehati- hatian; 3. Memberikan panduan dalam implementasi Tata Kelola Teknologi dan Informasi serta manajemen layanan Teknologi dan Informasi sehingga tercapai penerapan teknologi yang efektif, efisien, aman dan terencana; 4. Menerapkan tujuan Tata Kelola Teknologi dan Informasi pada strategi dan konteks Korporasi untuk mengambil keputusan prioritas pengelolaan sistem hingga pelaksanaan prioritas tujuan manajemen; dan 5. Memperkuat penerapan ISO 27001:2013 Sistem Manajemen Keamanan Informasi (SMKI)/ Information Security Management System (ISMS).
Cakupan Kebijakan Tata Kelola Teknologi dan Informasi 1. Panduan Perencanaan Teknologi dan Informasi b. Pengelolaan Dokumen Kebijakan Teknologi dan Informasi; c. Pengelolaan Rencana Strategis Teknologi dan Informasi; d. Pengelolaan Arsitektur Teknologi dan Informasi; e. Pengelolaan Anggaran Teknologi dan Informasi; dan f. Pengelolaan Proyek Teknologi dan Informasi.
Information and Communication Technology Policies and Institutions The Corporation’s ICT policy regulations include: 1. Circular Letter of the Ministry of Communication and Information No. 05/SE/M.Kominfo/07/2011 on the Implementation of Information Security Governance for Public Service Providers; 2. Governor of DKI Jakarta Decree No. 96 of 2004 on the Implementation of Good Corporate Governance Practices for Regional-Owned Enterprises (BUMD) within DKI Jakarta Province; 3. Joint Decision of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors of PT MRT Jakarta No. 007 of 2023/No. 060 of 2023 on the Corporate Governance Guidelines within PT MRT Jakarta; 4. Board of Directors Regulation No. 060 of 2023 on Information and Technology Governance Guidelines within PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda); and 5. Board of Directors Decision No. 042 of 2023 on the Establishment of the Digital Transformation Committee (TDI).
The Corporation’s ICT policy objectives: 1. Establishing fundamental principles for managing Information and Technology to mitigate potential risks, considering the Corporation’s business complexity and applying best practices; 2. Providing direction to ensure that the management of Information and Technology aligns with fundamental technology management principles and prudential principles; 3. Providing guidance in implementing Information and Technology Governance and service management to achieve effective, efficient, secure, and well-planned technology adoption; 4. Aligning Information and Technology Governance objectives with the Corporation’s strategy and context to support priority decision-making in system management and executing key management goals; and 5. Strengthening the implementation of ISO 27001:2013 Information Security Management System (ISMS).
Scope of Information and Technology Governance Policy 1. Guidelines for Information and Technology Planning a. Managing Information and Technology Policy Documents; b. Managing Information and Technology Strategic Plans; c. Managing Information and Technology Architecture; d. Managing Information and Technology Budgeting; and e. Managing Information and Technology Projects.

Pemeliharaan Sistem dan Aplikasi.
3. Panduan Operasional Teknologi dan Informasi a. Pengelolaan Layanan Teknologi dan Informasi; b. Penanganan Insiden dan Masalah; c. Pengelolaan Implementasi dan Perubahan; d. Pengelolaan Hak Akses; e. Pengelolaan Sistem dan Infrastruktur; f. Pengelolaan Kapasitas Teknologi dan Informasi; dan g. Pengadaan Barang dan Jasa Teknologi dan Informasi.
4. Panduan Manajemen Data 5. Panduan Manajemen Asset TIK Tantangan Pengembangan Teknologi Informasi dan Komputasi Tahun 2024 Terdapat beberapa tantangan Teknologi Informasi dan Komunikasi (TIK), antara lain: 1. Standarisasi Pengembangan Aplikasi Non-Enterprise yang dibutuhkan Korporasi menggunakan Technology Stack yang sama; 2. Perubahan strategi TIK dari support menjadi enabler; 3. Sosialisasi Kebijakan Implementasi dan Pengembangan Aplikasi yang sebelumnya dikerjakan oleh Pihak Ketiga (Vendor) menjadi InHouse Development dengan sistem Pipeline (Antrian); 4. Revitalisasi Divisi Information System & Technology (IST) dengan mengembangkan Technical Skill untuk mengurangi ketergantungan terhadap Pihak Ketiga sehingga proses bisnis Divisi IST menjadi lebih Agile; 5. Peningkatan IT Awareness dan IT Maturity sebagai pendukung proses Transformasi Digital Perseroan; dan 6. Adanya persyaratan kepatuhan baru terkait Keamanan Siber dan Pelindungan Data Pribadi (PDP).
Peta Jalan Pengembangan TIK Perseroan Peta Jalan pengembangan TIK mengacu Peraturan Direktur No. 060 Tahun 2023 tentang Pedoman Tata Kelola Teknologi dan Informasi di Lingkungan PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda). Pengembangan TIK untuk kebutuhan operasional, maupun korporasi dilaksanakan oleh Divisi Information System & Technology (IST).
2. Guidelines for Information and Technology Development a. Identifying Information and Technology Development Solutions; b. Developing Information and Technology Solutions and Services; c. Testing Information and Technology Solutions and Services; and d. Maintaining Systems and Applications.
3. Guidelines for Information and Technology Operation a. Managing Information and Technology Services; b. Handling Incidents and Issues; c. Managing Implementation and Changes; d. Managing Access Rights; e. Managing Systems and Infrastructure; f. Managing Information and Technology Capacity; and g. Procuring Information and Technology Goods and Services.
4. Guidelines for Data Management 5. Guidelines for ICT Asset Management.
Challenges of Information and Computing Technology Development in 2024 There are several challenges in Information and Communication Technology (ICT), including: 1. Standardization of non-enterprise application development required by the Corporation using the same technology stack; 2. Transformation of ICT strategy from a support function to an enabler; 3. Dissemination of policy for application implementation and development, shifting from third-party vendors to in-house development using a pipeline (queue) system; 4. Revitalization of the Information System & Technology (IST) Division by enhancing technical skills to reduce dependency on third parties, making the IST Division’s business processes more agile; 5. Improvement of IT awareness and IT maturity to support the Corporation’s digital transformation process; and 6. Compliance with new regulatory requirements related to Cybersecurity and Personal Data Protection (PDP).
Corporate ICT Development Roadmap The ICT development roadmap refers to Director Regulation No. 060 of 2023 on the Guidelines for Technology and Information Governance within PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda). The development of ICT for both operational and corporate needs is carried out by the Information System & Technology (IST) Division.

Pemantauan dan Evaluasi Teknologi Informasi dan Komunikasi Pemantauan dan evaluasi penerapan dan pengembangan TIK dilakukan dengan melibatkan Audit Internal, sedangkan rencana audit TIK eksternal dilakukan pada tahun 2023 bersamaan dengan assessment dan kajian penyesuaian tata kelola TIK. Proses audit internal mencakup penerapan SMKI yang merujuk pada ketentuan ISO/IEC 27001:2013 Information Security Management System dan Kebijakan Keamanan Informasi Departemen Information System & Technology Management PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda). Divisi Information System & Technology (IST) juga terlibat dalam beberapa proses audit, termasuk Audit Keuangan oleh KAP yang ditunjuk oleh Korporasi, Audit Sistem Manajemen Pengamanan (SMP) untuk menyelaraskan dengan Kebijakan Keamanan Informasi yang sudah berlaku di Korporasi. Di luar itu semua, Divisi IST melaporkan Evaluasi Kinerja secara berkala setiap bulan kepada Direktur Terkait melalui agenda Directorate Review Meeting dan Laporan Berkala kepada Dewan Komisaris dan Komite Investasi & Transformasi Digital (bersama dengan Divisi Corporate Strategy).
Monitoring and Evaluation of Information and Communication Technology Monitoring and evaluation of ICT implementation and development are conducted by Internal Audit, while an external ICT audit was conducted in 2023 alongside the assessment and review of ICT governance adjustments.
The internal audit process includes the implementation of the Information Security Management System (ISMS), referring to the provisions of ISO/IEC 27001:2013 Information Security Management System and the Information Security Policy of the Information System & Technology Management Department of PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda).
The Information System & Technology (IST) Division is also involved in several audit processes, including Financial Audits by the Public Accounting Firm (KAP) appointed by the Corporation, as well as Security Management System (SMP) audits to align with the Corporation’s existing Information Security Policy. Moreover, the IST Division regularly reports its Performance Evaluation on a monthly basis to the relevant Director through the Directorate Review Meeting agenda and submits Periodic Reports to the Board of Commissioners and the Investment & Digital Transformation Committee (together with the Corporate Strategy Division).

tata laksana berbasis COBIT 2019 Implementing COBIT 2019-based governance and administration 775 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Etika Penyebaran Informasi Non-Publik Perseroan menekankan pentingnya etika penyebaran informasi non-publik oleh karyawan MRT Jakarta. Segenap karyawan diwajibkan untuk menjaga kerahasiaan semua informasi non-publik mengenai Perseroan, serta yang berkaitan dengan pelanggan, mitra, maupun pihak lainnya yang diperoleh selama bekerja di Perseroan. Pengungkapan informasi rahasia tersebut kepada pihak-pihak yang tidak berkepentingan dilarang dilakukan, baik pada masa bakti karyawan maupun masa purnabakti.
Seiring dengan operasional Perseroan yang memerlukan pelayanan data dan informasi terkini, sampai dengan akhir tahun 2024, Divisi IST terus memperbaharui sistem keamanan informasi, termasuk keamanan informasi non- publik. Divisi IST juga memastikan keamanan/privasi data pelanggan berjalan dengan baik. Selama tahun 2024, Perseroan tidak pernah menerima pengaduan terkait dugaan penyebaran informasi non-publik oleh internal Perseroan untuk kepentingan pihak tertentu (insider trading). Perseroan juga tidak pernah menerima pengaduan terkait dugaan kebocoran maupun penyalahgunaan data pelanggan oleh pihak-pihak tidak bertanggung jawab.
Strategi Information Technology Governance Di tahun 2024, Perseroan telah melakukan beberapa hal untuk meningkatkan skor IT Maturity dan serta lebih memperlihatkan peran Divisi IST yang berubah menjadi Technology Enabler di Korporasi dengan kegiatan-kegiatan inisiatif berikut: 1. Perkuatan Unit Kerja IT dengan penambahan sub unit kerja IT dalam mendukung kebutuhan IT Business Analyst, IT Planning & Quality Assurance, IT Data Management; 2. Kajian dan Penyesuaian IT Master Plan dan IT Enterprise Architecture; 3. Penyesuaian Prosedur Pendukung Tata Kelola TI dan Dokumen Turunannya (Instruksi Kerja dan Form); dan 4. Penyediaan Tools Enterprise Architecture.
Di luar kegiatan Inisiatif yang sudah dilakukan, terdapat juga kegiatan rutin yang dilakukan Divisi Information System & Technology untuk tetap mempertahankan skor IT Maturity tersebut meliputi: 1. Penguatan Implementasi Tata Kelola TI; 2. Penguatan Implementasi Manajemen Risiko TI; 3. Pelaksanaan Audit TI; 4. Pelaporan Rutin TI ke Direksi dan Komite TI; 5. Optimalisasi Aplikasi IT Service Management (ITSM); 6. Pembaruan Service Catalogue dan Service Level TI; dan 7. Bekerja sama dengan Divisi ERMA terkait IT Contigency Plan.
Ethical Dissemination of Non-Public Information The Corporation emphasizes the importance of ethical conduct in the disclosure of non-public information by MRT Jakarta employees. All employees are required to maintain the confidentiality of all non-public information regarding the Corporation, as well as information related to ridership, partners, and other parties obtained during their tenure at the Corporation. The disclosure of such confidential information to unauthorized parties is strictly prohibited, both during and after an employee’s service period.
In line with the Corporation’s operations, which require up-to-date data and information services, the IST Division continued to enhance information security systems, including the protection of non-public information until the end of 2024. The IST Division also ensured the proper safeguarding of ridership data privacy. Throughout 2024, the Corporation did not receive any complaints regarding alleged disclosure of non-public information by internal parties for personal or external interests (insider trading). Additionally, no complaints had been received regarding suspected data leaks or misuse of ridership data by unauthorized parties.
Information Technology Governance Strategy In 2024, the Corporation took several initiatives to improve its IT Maturity score and further establish the IST Division’s evolving role as a Technology Enabler within the Corporation through the following strategic actions: 1. Strengthening the IT Work Unit by adding sub-units to support the needs of IT Business Analysts, IT Planning & Quality Assurance, and IT Data Management; 2. Reviewing and adjusting the IT Master Plan and IT Enterprise Architecture; 3. Aligning IT Governance Support Procedures and its derivative documents (Work Instructions and Forms); and 4. Providing Enterprise Architecture Tools.
In addition to the initiatives that had been implemented, the Information System & Technology Division also carried out routine activities to maintain the IT Maturity score, including: 1. Strengthening the implementation of IT Governance; 2. Enhancing the implementation of IT Risk Management; 3. Conducting IT Audits; 4. Regular IT reporting to the Board of Directors and the IT Committee; 5. Optimizing the IT Service Management (ITSM) application; 6. Updating the IT Service Catalogue and Service Levels; and 7. Collaborating with the ERMA Division on the IT Contingency Plan.
776 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance Keamanan dari Gangguan dan Cyber Security Sistem Manajemen Keamanan Informasi (SMKI) adalah sebuah kerangka kerja yang dirancang untuk mengelola dan melindungi informasi MRT Jakarta. Pada umumnya, Perseroan yang menerapkan SMKI bertujuan untuk memastikan kerahasiaan, integritas, dan ketersediaan informasi yang sangat penting bagi kelangsungan operasional serta untuk menjaga reputasi MRT Jakarta. Perseroan telah menyusun infrastruktur Sistem Manajemen Keamanan Informasi (SMKI) sesuai dengan standar SNI ISO 27001:2013, yang mencakup seluruh proses bisnis di Perseroan. Untuk memastikan implementasi Sistem Manajemen Keamanan Informasi (SMKI) yang efektif di seluruh Unit Kerja MRT Jakarta, diperlukan adanya kegiatan audit internal sebagai bentuk pemantauan dan evaluasi. Kegiatan audit ini berfokus pada tiga prinsip utama, yaitu C-I-A (Confidentiality, Integrity, dan Availability), serta bertujuan untuk memastikan bahwa kontrol-kontrol yang tercantum dalam Statement of Applicability (SoA) dilaksanakan sesuai dengan regulasi yang berlaku.
Pada tahun 2024, MRT Jakarta telah melakukan Security Hardening (Penguatan Keamanan) untuk Infrastruktur Teknologi Informasi (Server, Firewall, Access Point, dsb). Selain itu, setiap pengembangan aplikasi dilakukan Code Review (Tinjauan Kode) dan VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing) untuk mencegah serangan siber di aplikasi-aplikasi yang dapat diakses dan digunakan oleh Publik seperti Website Korporasi dan MyMRTJ Apps.
Security from Disruptions and Cyber Security The Information Security Management System (ISMS) is a framework designed to manage and protect MRT Jakarta’s information. Generally, the corporations that implement ISMS aim to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of critical information essential for operational continuity and maintaining MRT Jakarta’s reputation.
The Corporation has established an Information Security Management System (ISMS) infrastructure in accordance with the SNI ISO 27001:2013 standard, covering all business processes within the Corporation.
To ensure the effective implementation of the Information Security Management System (ISMS) across all Work Units of MRT Jakarta, internal audits are required as a form of monitoring and evaluation. These audit activities focus on three main principles: C-I-A (Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability) and aim to ensure that the controls outlined in the Statement of Applicability (SoA) are implemented in compliance with applicable regulations.
In 2024, MRT Jakarta carried out Security Hardening for its Information Technology Infrastructure (including Servers, Firewalls, Access Points, etc.). Additionally, every application development underwent Code Review and VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing) to prevent cyberattacks on publicly accessible applications such as Corporate Website and MyMRTJ Apps.
Peningkatan layanan dan kepuasan pengguna menjadi salah satu upaya yang terus dilakukan Perseroan Improving service and user satisfaction is one of the efforts that the Corporation continues to make 777 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Laporan Harta Kekayaan Penyelenggara Negara (LHKPN) Perseroan telah menetapkan Pedoman Pengelolaan LHKPN yang tertuang dalam Peraturan Direksi No. 008 Tahun 2023 tentang Pengelolaan Laporan Harta Kekayaan Penyelenggara Negara. Pedoman tersebut mengatur tata cara penyampaian, pengelolaan LHKPN, pejabat di lingkungan PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) yang wajib menyampaikan LHKPN dan sanksi bagi yang tidak melaporkan LHKPN. Berdasarkan Pedoman Pengelolaan LHKPN, pejabat di lingkungan PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) yang wajib menyampaikan LHKPN, yaitu: 1. Dewan Komisaris Perseroan; 2. Direksi Perseroan; 3. Dewan Komisaris Anak Perusahaan dan/atau Perusahaan Patungan; 4. Direksi Anak Perusahaan dan/atau Perusahaan Patungan atau yang setara; 5. Kepala Divisi Perseroan, Anak Perusahaan, dan/atau Perusahaan Patungan atau yang setara; 6. Kepala Departemen Perseroan atau yang setara; dan/atau 7. Karyawan lainnya yang berdasarkan permintaan Direktur diwajibkan menyampaikan LHKPN.

Laporan Harta Kekayaan Penyelenggara Negara (LHKPN) State Officials Wealth Report (LHKPN) The Corporation has established Guidelines for the Management of LHKPN, as outlined in Board of Directors Regulation No. 008 of 2023 on the Management of the State Officials' Wealth Report (LHKPN). These guidelines regulate the procedures for submission and management of LHKPN, the officials within PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) who are required to submit LHKPN, and the sanctions for those who fail to report it. Based on the LHKPN Management Guidelines, the officials within PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) required to submit LHKPN include: 1. The Corporation’s Board of Commissioners; 2. The Corporation’s Board of Directors; 3. The Board of Commissioners of Subsidiaries and/or Joint Ventures; 4. The Board of Directors of Subsidiaries and/or Joint Ventures or equivalent positions; 5. Division Heads of the Corporation, Subsidiaries, and/ or Joint Ventures or equivalent positions; 6. Department Heads of the Corporation or equivalent positions; and/or 7. Other employees who, at the request of the Director, are required to submit LHKPN.

1.1 Peran dan Tanggung Jawab Direksi.
Roles and Responsibilities of the Board of Directors.
Rekomendasi | Recommendation 1.1.1 Untuk mencapai penciptaan nilai yang berkelanjutan, Direksi menjalankan peran kepemimpinannya dan berupaya mencapai hasil governansi sebagai berikut: 1. Berdaya saing dan berfokus ke kinerja jangka panjang; 2. Beretika dan bertanggung jawab dalam menjalankan bisnis; 3. Berkontribusi positif terhadap masyarakat dan lingkungan; serta 4. Berkemampuan dalam bertahan dan bertumbuh (corporate resilience).
In order to achieve sustainable value creation, the Board of Directors exercises its leadership role and strives to attain the following governance outcomes: 1. Competitive and focused on long-term performance; 2. Ethical and responsible in conducting business; 3. Positively contributing to society and the environment; and 4. Capable of resilience and growth (corporate resilience).
Apply MRT Jakarta memiliki sasaran strategi yang bertujuan untuk mencapai penciptaan nilai yang berkelanjutan. Dalam hal ini dijelaskan bahwa Direksi menjalankan perannya melalui: 1. Berdaya saing a. People Agenda (Meningkatkan kapabilitas SDM dan kualitas untuk mendukung tercapainya tiga poros Perseroan); dan b. KM & Innovation Agenda Mendukung peningkatan kapabilitas riset, knowledge creation dan budaya lesson learning di internal organisasi.
2. Beretika dan bertanggung jawab dalam menjalankan bisnis. MRT Jakarta senantiasa mengedepankan kejujuran, respect, memenuhi komitmen, membangun serta menjaga nilai-nilai moral dan kepercayaan secara konsisten. Hal ini dibuktikan dengan penandatanganan Code of Conduct setiap tahun oleh seluruh Insan MRT Jakarta; 3. Berkontribusi positif terhadap masyarakat dan lingkungan Hal ini dilaksanakan melalui program CSR Perseroan terhadap lingkungan hidup, pelanggan, pengembangan sosial masyarakat, ketenagakerjaan, kesehatan, dan keselamatan kerja. Hal ini dibuktikan dengan revitalisasi ruang terbuka hijau di dalam Taman Literasi Martha Tiahahu, Blok M. Selain itu, Perseroan memberikan kemudahan di sekitar kawasan MRT Jakarta dengan pembangunan alaspadu dan rumapadu; dan 4. Berkemampuan dalam bertahan dan bertumbuh. MRT Jakarta bertahan dengan menjaga zero layoff dan terus mendorong inovasi dalam bisnis dengan mengembangkan jalur dan kinerja konstruksinya, serta menambah lini bisnis baru seperti jasa pelatihan dan konsultasi baik dalam level nasional dan internasional.
MRT Jakarta has strategic goals aimed at achieving sustainable value creation. In this regard, it is explained that the Board of Directors fulfils its role through: 1. Competitiveness a. People Agenda (Enhancing human resource capabilities and quality to support the achievement of the Corporation’s three strategic pillars); and b. KM & Innovation Agenda (Supporting the development of research capabilities, knowledge creation, and a lesson-learning culture within the organization).
2. Ethical and responsible business practices. MRT Jakarta consistently upholds honesty, respect, commitment fulfilment, and the establishment as well as upholding of moral values and trust. This commitment is demonstrated through the annual signing of the Code of Conduct by all MRT Jakarta employee; 780 PT MRT JAKARTA (PERSERODA) • Laporan Tahunan 2024 Annual Report Tata Kelola Perusahaan Good Corporate Governance No.
Uraian Description Apply/Explain Penerapan di MRT Jakarta Implementation at MRT Jakarta 3. Positive contribution to society and the environment. This is carried out through the Corporation’s CSR programs focusing on environmental sustainability, customer welfare, community development, employment, health, and occupational safety. A key example is the revitalization of green open spaces within Taman Literasi Martha Tiahahu, Blok M. Additionally, the Corporation has enhanced accessibility around the MRT Jakarta area by developing Alaspadu and Rumapadu; 4. Resilience and growth capability. MRT Jakarta ensures resilience by maintaining a zero-layoff policy while continuously driving business innovation. This includes expanding rail routes, improving construction performance, and introducing new business lines such as training and consultancy services at both national and international levels.
1.1.2 Direksi harus memastikan bahwa misi, visi, tujuan, sasaran, strategi, dan rencana tahunan dan jangka menengah korporasi konsisten dengan tujuan jangka panjang, dengan memanfaatkan inovasi dan teknologi secara efektif.
The Board of Directors must ensure that the corporation’s mission, vision, objectives, goals, strategies, and annual and medium-term plans are consistent with its long-term goals, effectively leveraging innovation and technology.
Apply Direksi telah mengambil sejumlah kebijakan strategis yang sejalan dengan rencana bisnis Perseroan dan rencana jangka panjang perusahaan. Direksi memastikan bahwa visi Perseroan yaitu Menjadi penyedia sarana transportasi publik terdepan, yang berkomitmen untuk mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi melalui peningkatan mobilitas, pengurangan kemacetan, dan pengembangan sistem transit perkotaan konsisten dengan tujuan jangka panjang Perseroan yang memanfaatkan inovasi dan teknologi secara efektif. Perseroan telah menetapkan IT Masterplan 2022-2025 yang selaras dengan RJPP .
The Board of Directors has implemented several strategic policies aligned with the Corporation's business plan and long-term corporate strategy. The Board of Directors ensures that the Corporation's vision, which is To become a leading provider of public transportation, committed to driving economic growth through enhanced mobility, reduced congestion, and the development of an urban transit system, remains consistent with its long-term objectives by effectively leveraging innovation and technology. The Corporation has established the IT Masterplan 2022-2025, which is aligned with RJPP .
1.1.3 Direksi memastikan bahwa korporasi menerapkan manajemen risiko dan sistem pengendalian internal yang tepat dan efektif, yang selaras dengan visi, misi, tujuan, sasaran, dan strategi korporasi serta mematuhi peraturan perundang-undangan dan standar yang berlaku.
The Board of Directors ensures that the corporation implements appropriate and effective risk management and internal control systems in line with its vision, mission, objectives, goals, and strategies while complying with applicable laws and regulations, as well as standards.
Apply Direksi telah memastikan penerapan manajemen risiko melalui proses bisnis manajemen risiko yang di dalamnya terdapat matriks pengukuran tingkat kematangan manajemen risiko dan risk culture yang senantiasa meningkat. Selain itu, sistem pengendalian internal ditetapkan melalui Peraturan Direksi No. PER/023-1/BOD-MRT/IX/2021 tentang Pedoman Sistem Pengendalian Internal di Lingkungan PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda) serta pengukuran penilaian efektifitas SPI yang dilakukan setiap tahun.
The Board of Directors has ensured the implementation of risk management through a structured risk management business process, which includes a risk management maturity assessment matrix and a continuously improving risk culture. Additionally, the internal control system has been established through Board of Directors Regulation No. PER/023-1/BOD-MRT/IX/2021 on Guidelines for the Internal Control System within PT MRT Jakarta (Perseroda), with an annual evaluation conducted to assess the effectiveness of the internal control system (SPI).

The Board of Directors ensures the integrity of the corporation’s accounting and financial reporting system, as well as the timely and accurate disclosure of all material information regarding the corporation.

The Annual Financial Reports are also audited by a Third Party and approved in the Annual GMS.

The Board of Directors has ensured that the sustainability report has been prepared in accordance with the indicators set by POJK and GRI Standards.
1.1.6 Direksi membangun kerangka kerja untuk governansi teknologi informasi (TI), korporasi yang selaras dengan kebutuhan dan prioritas bisnis korporasi, mendorong peluang dan kinerja bisnis, memperkuat manajemen risiko, serta mendukung tujuan dan strategi korporasi.
The Board of Directors establishes a corporate information technology (IT) governance framework that aligns with the corporation’s business needs and priorities, drives business opportunities and performance, strengthens risk management, and supports the corporation’s goals and strategies.
Apply MRT Jakarta telah memperbaharui IT Masterplan yang selaras dengan strategi Korporasi, serta terus mengembangkan knowledge management dalam platform Knowledge, Information, and Education Center (Kinetic), MRTJ Integrated Risk Asessment (MIRA) sebagai platform internal yang dapat digunakan oleh Insan MRT Jakarta untuk mengelola pengetahuan sekaligus sebagai intranet portal menuju berbagai aplikasi digital internal. MRT Jakarta juga telah menerapkan pendekatan konstruksi digital (digital construction), dengan mekanisme common data environment (CDE) untuk pengembangan MRT Jakarta Lin Utara-Selatan Fase 2.
MRT Jakarta has updated its IT Masterplan in line with the Corporation’s strategy and continues to develop knowledge management through the Knowledge, Information, and Education Center (Kinetic) platform. Moreover, the MRTJ Integrated Risk Assessment (MIRA) serves as an internal platform that enables MRT Jakarta employee to manage knowledge while also functioning as an intranet portal for accessing various internal digital applications. MRT Jakarta has also implemented a digital construction approach using a common data environment (CDE) mechanism for the development of MRT Jakarta North-South Line Phase 2.
1.1.7 Bagi korporasi yang menjalankan kegiatan usaha berdasarkan prinsip syariah, Direksi perlu memastikan kewenangan dan ketersediaan perangkat pendukung yang memadai agar Dewan Pengawas Syariah dapat menjalankan perannya dengan efektif.
For corporations conducting business based on Sharia principles, the Board of Directors must ensure the authority and availability of adequate supporting mechanisms to enable the Sharia Supervisory Board to effectively fulfill its role.
